item.title: Kim Min-seok's 'Shincheonji intervention in party convention' claims… Jeong Cheong-rae says "false, will take legal action" (김민석 ‘전당대회 신천지 개입설’에…정청래 “허위, 법적 조치할 것”)
item.description:
Allegations of 'Shincheonji intervention' are emerging in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 party convention leadership race. Candidate Kim Min-seok has taken the lead in raising suspicions, with Candidate Song Young-gil joining in. Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae has signaled a strong response, stating, "I will take legal action against every single one." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 경선에 ‘신천지 개입설’이 불거지고 있다. 김민석 후보가 주도적으로 의혹을 제기하고 송영길 후보가 가세하면서다. 정청래 후보는 “족족 법적 조처를 하겠다”며 강력한 대응을 예고했다.)

After a 'meeting invited candidates for party leader' held at the Seoul Metropolitan Council in Jung-gu, Seoul on the 21st, Candidate Kim met with reporters and said, "Breaking the triple alliance of 'anti-Myung,' 'factionalism,' and 'Shincheonji' is the essence of this party convention," adding, "I will point out one by one the fact that the 'Shincheonji special counsel' was not pursued." In a radio interview with MBC on the same day, he added, "When I first warned about martial law, everyone said I was crazy and asked what I was talking about. I am also watching the Shincheonji issue very specifically and carefully. I will speak up at appropriate times." However, Candidate Kim did not provide specific evidence. (김 후보는 21일 서울 중구 서울시의회에서 열린 ‘당대표 후보자 초청 간담회’를 마친 뒤 취재진과 만나 “‘반명’ ‘분열주의’ ‘신천지’의 3자 연합을 깨는 것이 이번 전당대회의 본질”이라며 “‘신천지 특검’이 진행되지 않은 점 등을 하나하나 짚어가겠다”고 말했다. 그는 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 인터뷰에서도 “제가 계엄을 처음 경고할 때 다들 정신 나갔다고 뭔 소리냐 이랬는데, 신천지 문제도 아주 구체적이고 주의 깊게 보고 있다”며 “적정한 시기마다 말하겠다”고 덧붙였다. 다만, 김 후보는 구체적인 근거는 내놓지 않았다.)

Candidate Kim's mention of Shincheonji is interpreted as targeting Candidate Jeong. (김 후보의 신천지 언급은 정 후보를 겨냥한 것으로 풀이된다.)

On YouTube, videos claiming that Candidate Jeong attended Shincheonji events in the past are circulating, along with assertions that Candidate Jeong, as the party leader at the time, bore significant responsibility for the collapse of the 'Unification Church and Shincheonji special counsel' earlier this year. It appears that messages are being sent to party members suggesting that Shincheonji followers are supporting Candidate Jeong to foment division within the ruling camp. An aide to Candidate Kim stated, "During the 2021 Democratic Party presidential primary, circumstances indicating political intervention by a specific religious group were revealed; this is an extension of that issue." (유튜브에서는 정 후보가 과거 신천지 행사에 참석했다고 주장하는 영상과 함께 올해 초 ‘통일교·신천지 특검’이 무산된 배경에는 당시 대표였던 정 후보의 책임이 적지 않다는 주장이 돌고 있다. 신천지 신도들이 정 후보를 지지해 여권 내 분열을 꾀하려 한다는 메시지를 당원들에게 발신한 것으로 보인다. 김 후보 쪽 의원은 “2021년 민주당 대선 경선 당시 특정 종교 집단의 정치 개입 정황이 드러난 바 있는데 그 연장선의 문제 제기”라고 말했다.)

Candidate Song also joined in. On the same day, Candidate Song wrote on Facebook, "I heard a shocking story about the meeting between Shincheonji leader Lee Man-hee and senior member Hong Jun-pyo after the 2021 People Power Party presidential primary. I will cross-check a few things and then talk about it on a broadcast." This suggested an atmosphere that cases of Shincheonji intervening in the People Power Party's internal primary could also occur within the Democratic Party. (송 후보도 가세했다. 송 후보는 이날 페이스북에 “(2021년 국민의힘) 대선 (경선) 후 이만희 (신천지) 교주와 홍준표 선배가 직접 만나 나눈 충격적인 이야기를 들었다. 몇가지 크로스체크를 한 후 방송에서 이야기하도록 하겠다”고 적었다. 신천지가 국민의힘 당내 경선에 개입했던 사례가 민주당에도 있을 수 있다는 분위기를 풍긴 것이다.)

Candidate Jeong responded strongly, calling it "false fabricated information" and "fake news." Meeting with reporters at the National Assembly, he said, "They keep bringing up Shincheonji and pretending as if I am related, but if they get caught, I will take legal action against every single one." (정 후보는 “허위 조작 정보” “가짜뉴스”라며 격한 반응을 보였다. 그는 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “자꾸 신천지 얘기하면서 마치 저하고 관련이 있는 것처럼 연기를 피우는데, 걸리면 족족 다 법적 조치를 하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the claim that he intentionally did not push for the Unification Church and Shincheonji special counsel as party leader, Candidate Jeong said, "At the time, we were conducting multiple special counsels, and due to a shortage of dispatched prosecutors, the party, government, and presidential office coordinated to have the joint investigation unit of the prosecution and police handle the case." Regarding the YouTube videos claiming he attended Shincheonji-related events, he said, "It was a district office event where then-Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol also attended and gave a congratulatory speech." Candidate Lee Seong-yoon, a close associate of Candidate Jeong and candidate for the Supreme Council, opposed on Facebook, saying, "Spreading baseless suspicions to sow discord within and foster distrust is a method used only by cults." (정 후보는 당대표 당시 통일교·신천지 특검을 일부러 추진하지 않았다는 주장에 대해서는 “당시 특검을 여러개 하다 보니 파견 검사가 부족하다고 해 검찰·경찰 합동수사본부가 수사하는 걸로 하자고 당·정·청이 조율한 것”이라고 말했다. 신천지 관련 행사에 자신이 참여했다고 하는 유튜브 영상에 대해서는 “구윤철 당시 기획재정부 차관도 참석해 축사도 한 지역구 행사”라고 말했다. 정 후보와 가까운 이성윤 최고위원 후보는 페이스북에 “근거 없는 의혹을 퍼뜨려 내부를 이간질하고, 불신을 조장하여 이득을 보는 건 사이비 종교나 쓰는 방법”이라고 반발했다.)

Amidst this, Candidate Jeong's side announced that after completing a joint campaign speech for party leader candidates at the Democratic Party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul the previous day, the vehicle carrying Candidate Jeong was damaged by an external impact. Candidate Jeong said, "I have requested an investigation by the police." (이런 가운데 정 후보 쪽은 전날 서울 여의도 민주당 중앙당사에서 당대표 후보 합동연설회를 마친 뒤 정 후보가 탄 차량이 외부의 가격을 받아 파손됐다고 밝혔다. 정 후보는 “경찰에 수사 의뢰를 했다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party decided that day to reduce the candidate deposits for the party leader and Supreme Council elections by 20 million won each. Rep. Im Ho-seon, the deputy chairman of the party's election management committee, told reporters after the committee's plenary meeting at the National Assembly, "The candidate deposits (combining preliminary and main primaries) were set at 80 million won for party leader candidates and 30 million won for Supreme Council candidates." The deposits for this party convention were originally 100 million won for party leader candidates and 50 million won for Supreme Council candidates. On the 19th, President Lee Jae-myung suggested on X, "If possible, how about considering restoring the deposits to their previous levels?" (한편, 민주당은 이날 당대표·최고위원 선거 후보 기탁금을 각각 2천만원씩 낮추기로 결정했다. 당 선거관리위원회 부위원장인 임호선 의원은 선관위 전체회의를 마친 뒤 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “(예비경선과 본경선을 합한) 후보자 기탁금을 당대표 후보는 8천만원, 최고위원 후보는 3천만원으로 각각 확정했다”고 말했다. 이번 전당대회 기탁금은 당대표 후보가 1억원, 최고위원 후보가 5천만원이었다. 지난 19일 이재명 대통령은 엑스(X)에 “가능하다면 기탁금을 종전 수준으로 되돌리는 걸 고려해보시면 어떨까 한다”고 제안했다.)

Reports by Ko Han-sol, Jeong Hye-min, and Ko Kyung-ju sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 정혜민 고경주 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Repealing Supplementary Investigations Would Be Worst-Case Reform" "Unchecked Prosecutors Are the Real Danger" (“보완수사 폐지 땐 최악 개혁” “통제없는 검사가 진짜 위험”)
item.description:
On the 21st, the Democratic Party of Korea held a policy caucus meeting on the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority to hear expert opinions. Amid rising voices within and outside the party to allow supplementary investigation authority on an exceptional basis following the 'Jang Yun-gi case', experts attending the caucus were sharply divided between support and opposition. <<> Professor Park Chan-woon of Hanyang University Law School, former head of the Advisory Committee of the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office, argued in his presentation that "the core of prosecution reform is not supplementary investigations, and if supplementary investigations are also abolished, prosecution reform will become the worst possible outcome." He expressed concern that "the abolition of supplementary investigations is a product of the anger toward the prosecution that spread after Yoon Seok-youl's impeachment" and "if handled poorly, the abolition of supplementary investigations could lead to a crisis for the Democratic Party administration." <<> In contrast, Professor Yoo Seung-ik of Myongji University (Law) countered the argument that supplementary investigation authority should be partially retained to protect victims, stating, "Victim protection is not a task that can be resolved by relying on prosecutors' charitable goodwill or direct investigation powers." Meanwhile, Professor Hwang Mun-gyu of Joongbu University (Police Administration) proposed an alternative, saying, "To mitigate the side effects of abolishing supplementary investigation authority, we could consider granting complainants, accusers, and victims the right to request a meeting with prosecutors, and giving prosecutors the authority to verify facts." <<> Attorney Kang Dong-pil, a former police officer, said, "Even without prosecutors' supplementary investigations, the police already handle investigative work in practice, so abolishing the authority poses no problem. The real danger is prosecutors' direct investigations without oversight," adding, "If we retain supplementary investigation authority, will prosecutors come to the scene for every single case to look for cable ties, as was problematic in the Jang Yun-gi case?" <<> Attorney Kim Kyu-hyun, a former prosecutor, referred to the Jang Yun-gi case, the Kim Chang-min director case, and the Busan kicking incident, stating, "Supplementary investigation authority is an essential power for investigations related to people's livelihoods. If we just abolish it now, a string of second and third Jang Yun-gi cases will erupt before the general and presidential elections. We must not rush into this fire pit that could cost us the government, like moths to a flame." Kim Hye-jeong, head of the Korea Sexual Violence Relief Center, said regarding the right to demand supplementary investigations, "The 2021 adjustment of investigation authority between police and prosecutors was an extremely difficult change for victims. Claiming everything will work out perfectly is unrealistic. If we must abolish it, there needs to be a process of persuasion." <<> Lawmaker Hong Gi-won, who proposed a bill to exceptionally retain supplementary investigation authority for cases involving socially vulnerable groups, secured an opportunity to speak, saying, "Granting supplementary investigation authority itself is about protecting victims, because no one outside the police can see distortions or mistakes in police investigations." When Professor Hwang Mun-gyu criticized his bill as "revealing an intention for comprehensive re-investigation power," Hong countered, "The bill clearly states that supplementary investigations must be conducted within the scope of the same offense, and if different charges emerge, it requires notifying investigative agencies (police, Serious Crime Investigation Office, etc.) to prevent separate investigations." <<> Meanwhile, the meeting hall, initially filled with lawmakers at the start of the caucus, became sparse as many left during the expert presentations. By the end of the meeting, only about 10 lawmakers remained. The National Assembly will open the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's first subcommittee on bill review on the 22nd to deliberate on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment. <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 21일 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 관한 정책 의원총회를 열어 전문가 의견을 들었다. ‘장윤기 사건’을 계기로 당 안팎에서 보완수사권을 예외적으로 허용해야 한다는 목소리가 고개를 든 가운데 의총에 참석한 전문가들의 찬반 입장 또한 팽팽히 갈렸다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: “‘New Lee Jae-myung’ Leader Likely President Lee…Prosecution Reform a Total Mess” (유시민 “‘뉴이재명’ 수장은 이 대통령일 가능성…검찰개혁 모든 게 엉망”)
item.description:
Writer Yoo Si-min said on the 21st that he "judged that the leader of the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is likely President Lee Jae-myung." This came as he argued that the 'confusion' that arose during the push for prosecution reform ultimately stemmed from the president's decisions. (유시민 작가가 “(이른바) ‘뉴이재명' 세력의 수장은 이재명 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 판단했다”고 21일 말했다. 검찰개혁 추진 과정에서 벌어진 ‘혼선’이 결국 이 대통령의 판단에 따른 것이라는 주장을 하면서다.)

Appearing on the YouTube show '2-Minute News' that day, Yoo criticized the Democratic Party of Korea's process of pushing for prosecution reform—including whether to retain supplementary investigative powers—calling it "misguided in both distinction (of public and private) and priorities, a total mess," and made these remarks. (유 작가는 이날 유튜브 방송 ‘2분뉴스’에 출연해 보완수사권 존치 여부 등을 둘러싼 더불어민주당의 검찰개혁 추진 과정을 “공사(구분)도, 우선순위도 잘못됐고, 모든 게 엉망이었다”고 비판하며 이같이 말했다.)

He said, "After observing the past six months, I've come to judge that it's not because (the president) had no time or was focused elsewhere. There's a high probability that all of this was orchestrated by the president," adding, "All the actions of 'New Lee Jae-myung' aren't just some riot by the self-proclaimed 'pro-Lee' faction, but something planned and initiated by the president and some aides we don't know well." (그는 “(지난) 6개월을 지켜본 결과, (이 대통령이) 시간이 없어서 또는 다른 데 집중하느라 그런 게 아니고, 이 모든 일은 이 대통령이 기획한 것일 가능성이 많다고 판단하게 됐다”며 “‘뉴이재명’이 하는 모든 행동이 자칭 ‘친명’(친이재명계)들이 벌이는 난동이 아니라 대통령과 우리가 잘 알지 못하는 어떤 참모들이 기획해 시작한 것”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "I've judged that the leader of the 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is not someone like Lee Eon-ju (Democratic Party lawmaker), but likely President Lee himself. I think it's time to speak up now." (그는 이어 “‘뉴이재명' 세력의 수장은 이언주 (민주당 의원) 같은 이런 사람이 아니고 이 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 판단했다. 이제는 말을 해야 할거 같다”고 했다.)

'New Lee Jae-myung' was initially a term coined to refer to the new influx of President Lee's supporters after last year's presidential election, but through the conflict phase over the merger between the Democratic Party and the Fatherland Innovation Party, it has come to be used among supporters to denote a faction distinct from the pro-Chung Cheong-rye and pro-Moon Jae-in factions. (‘뉴이재명'은 지난해 대선 이후 새로 유입된 이 대통령 지지층을 뜻하는 용어로 처음 만들어졌으나, 민주당과 조국혁신당의 합당 갈등 국면을 거치며 지지자들 사이에서 친정청래계·친문재인계와 구분되는 이 대통령 지지 세력을 지칭하는 표현으로 사용되고 있다.)

Yoo remarked, "The (amendment to) the Criminal Procedure Act (regarding whether to retain supplementary investigative powers) was supposed to be handled after the local elections. They ended the TF (the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office) activities, saying 'There's no government proposal. We'll leave it to the National Assembly,' and then lawmakers claiming to be pro-Lee introduced strange bills. They even put forward a Criminal Procedure Act amendment inconsistent with the Heavy Crime Investigation Office and the Corruption Investigation Office Act," adding, "Now it's time to see all this as the president's judgment." He further stated, "I can only judge that all of this happens because the president opposes the complete separation of investigation and prosecution. My hypothesis is that (the president) wants to keep the prosecution's investigative powers." (유 작가는 “(보완수사권 존치 여부를 결정할) 형사소송법(개정)은 지방선거가 끝난 뒤 하기로 하고, 티에프(TF·국무총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단) 활동을 종료하면서 ‘정부안은 없다. 국회에 맡기겠다’ 그래놓고 소위 친명을 자처하는 의원들은 이상한 법안을 냈다. 중수청(중대범죄수사청)·공수청법과 맞지도 않는 형사소송법 개정안을 또 내놨다”며 “이제는 이 모든 것이 대통령의 판단이라고 봐야 할 때가 됐다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이 모든 것들이 다 대통령이 수사·기소의 완전한 분리에 반대하기 때문에 생긴 일이라고밖에 판단할 수밖에 없다. (대통령이) 검찰의 수사권을 남겨놓고 싶어한다는 게 (제) 가설”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Yoo also said, "Absolute power corrupts 100%. No matter how high-quality the fish sold at a fishmonger's, it's bound to smell fishy. If left unchecked with no restrictions, every fishmonger will emit a stench." He added, "If you drive away critics saying 'Don't defame the fishmonger,' 'Are you inciting anti-fishmonger sentiment?' and silence them, eventually a rotten smell will emerge." (유 작가는 또한 “절대 권력은 100% 부패한다”며 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 파는 어물전도 비린내가 나기 마련이고, 어떤 제한도 두지 않고 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 썩은 내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 했다. 그는 “‘어물전 명예훼손하지 마’, ‘반(反)어물전 선동하는 것 아니냐’며 비판하는 사람을 쫓아내고 아무 말도 못 하게 하면 결국 썩은 내가 나게 된다”고 덧붙였다.)

By Ko Han-sol, Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: “The Democratic Party Never Even Holds a Discussion on Polarization… Is It Really the Party of the Middle Class and Ordinary People?” (“민주당, 양극화 토론 한번을 안해…중산층·서민의 정당 맞나”)
item.description:
Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 national convention, a debate over “orthodox lineage” has erupted among the party leadership candidates. One might wonder, “This isn’t a monarchy, so why this talk of orthodox lineage?” Yet, in reality, the current Democratic Party does not have many lawmakers who have consistently stood by the party since the days of President Kim Dae-jung’s Peace Democratic Party (PDP). While this is partly a natural change over time, it also reflects the Democratic Party’s tumultuous history of repeated splits and mergers. (더불어민주당의 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 당대표 후보들 사이에서 ‘적통’ 논쟁이 벌어졌다. ‘왕조시대도 아닌데 웬 적통 논쟁인가’ 싶은데, 정작 지금의 민주당엔 김대중 대통령의 평화민주당(평민당) 시절부터 당을 꾸준히 지켜온 의원들이 의외로 많지도 않다. 세월 흐름에 따른 자연스러운 변화이기도 하지만, 분당과 통합을 반복하며 부침이 많았던 민주당의 사정이 반영된 결과이기도 할 것이다.)

Lawmaker Woo Won-shik (five-term) is a living witness to this history of the Democratic Party. After leading a movement to oust former President Chun Doo-hwan and engaging in labor activism in Seoul’s Guro-dong area, he joined the Peace Democratic Party in 1988. Except for a brief period when he was elected Speaker of the 22nd National Assembly and temporarily stepped down from his party affiliation, he has spent 38 years continuously with the Democratic Party. ( 우원식 의원(5선)은 이런 민주당의 역사를 지켜본 산증인이다. 전두환 전 대통령 퇴진 운동을 벌이고 서울 구로동 등에서 노동운동을 하다 1988년 평화민주당에 입당한 그는 22대 국회 전반기 국회의장에 선출돼 잠시 당적을 내려놓은 걸 제외하곤 38년을 줄곧 민주당과 함께 했다. )

Meeting at the National Assembly Members’ Office Building on the 16th, when candidate registration for the Democratic Party’s national convention began, Woo expressed feeling “more frustrated and burdened than ever.” “It’s only been a year since we overcame the life-threatening crisis of an illegal martial law and insurrection with the people, and the Lee Jae-myung administration was established,” yet internal divisions have led to name-calling and talk of a “Myeong-Cheong War” (referring to a power struggle between factions), presenting an image of “internal power struggles.” He said, “I hear people saying that they don’t know who the Democratic Party is for anymore,” adding, “If the people’s disappointment grows and we fail (to regain power), I fear we might never be able to form a democratic government again.” <<> ―The race for the national convention has begun. What kind of image should the candidates show in this convention? <<> “After the impeachment of President Park Geun-hye, the people gave us power, but (due to our shortcomings) we lost it in just five years. Then, through the impeachment of President Yoon Suk-yeol, (the people) gave the Democratic Party another chance, but within a year of taking office, the people’s lives are regressing. Yet, the party is only showing power struggles. Going through the June 3 local elections, I felt ‘the Democratic Party is showing a face far removed from the people’s expectations.’ If the ‘4th Democratic Government’ fails due to internal division... then who would trust the Democratic Party and rally again to create a democratic government in the future? The next time will be truly difficult. This convention must create a very important opportunity for change, with that sense of urgency, to reshape a new Democratic Party that is closer to the people.” <<> ―You recently reminded people via Facebook that the Democratic Party aims to be “the party of the middle class and ordinary people, a national party.” What is the current state of the Democratic Party? <<> “Look at how difficult life is for the middle class and ordinary people now. The delinquency rate for small business owners’ loans has risen by 12%, and the average real estate price in Seoul has surpassed 1 billion won. On one hand, semiconductors are thriving and stock prices have surged, but those gains have not yet reached (the majority of) the people. Rather, the gap is widening, worsening polarization. Yet, I’ve never heard the Democratic Party, a ‘party of the middle class and ordinary people,’ raise polarization as an agenda item. Over the past year, it seems all we’ve done is push for prosecutorial and judicial reform. Also, amid growing concerns about the crisis of local extinction, the government brought forward an agenda for metropolitan integration, but the Democratic Party had no role in it. Even now, candidates running in the national convention talk about ‘what I’ve done in South Jeolla’ or ‘what I’ve done in Gwangju,’ but you rarely hear ‘what I’ve done in Busan or North Gyeongsang.’ That’s because party member votes are all concentrated in the Honam region.” <<> ―Yet, at the convention, the ‘abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers’ seems to be the biggest topic. <<> “The issue of supplementary investigative powers is about how to prevent harm to citizens that could arise from the police’s exclusive exercise of power when prosecutorial investigative powers are abolished, and it’s a matter of providing a clear alternative to reassure the people. But now, this issue has become a campaign strategy for the convention. It’s as if nothing matters unless ‘complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers’ is achieved. Even proposing ‘let’s deliberate on alternatives’ is treated as problematic, which closes off room for dialogue. I’m very worried about how the people might see us.” <<> ―On this issue, even supporters are divided and fighting as ‘Old Democratic Party’ vs. ‘New Lee Jae-myung.’ <<> “During President Kim Dae-jung’s era, many people from the conservative side joined the party. They were given key positions, like National Intelligence Service Director Lee Jong-chan or Presidential Chief of Staff Kim Joong-kwon. They didn’t go anywhere else afterward. They became one with the Democratic Party while realizing their own philosophies. (After the presidential election) New people who joined the party also did so because they agreed with the Democratic Party’s values. So, I don’t understand why we are dividing into factions and constantly trying to split the party internally. We need to consider that President Lee Jae-myung lost once and won once (in the last two presidential elections). Looking at the ‘progressive reform camp vs. conservative reactionary camp’ structure, it’s a difference of just over 1%. Last time, we lost because we were divided; this time, they were divided, so we won. Of course, when bringing in (new figures), we should go through a careful discussion process, but once they are inside, we should discuss differences internally and go through a process of becoming one. But what’s the situation now? Strangely, aren’t we using social media (SNS) to assert our opinions from outside the party, dividing into factions, and engaging in power struggles? If we keep dividing with ‘you’re different from me,’ what will be left? This way, we’ll fail. We’ll never be able to hold power permanently.” <<> ―At the convention, party member sovereignty is being emphasized. The intent seems to be to better reflect the people’s voices in setting the party’s agenda, but there are also criticisms that the party is being overly swayed by the voices of hardline supporters. <<> “Expanding party members’ participation and authority is something a democratic party should naturally do. However, to properly reflect the people’s voices, there needs to be sufficient debate (on issues), but currently, the Democratic Party has no process of deliberation. It’s only about voting. As a result, instead of finding a ‘line’ of agreement, we repeatedly see conflicts and clashes when opinions don’t match.” <<> ―During the convention process, the issue of handling the special counsel bill on fabricated indictments, which grants the authority to withdraw indictments, is likely to become a point of contention. <<> “Illegal issues arising from prosecutorial investigations—whether there were fabrications or coercion—must be clearly revealed through a special counsel to set an example. However, there seems to be significant public disagreement over whether to grant the special counsel the authority to withdraw indictments. That part requires sufficient and careful social discussion. Ultimately, if the fabrication of the indictment is revealed, wouldn’t the court handle it appropriately?” <<> ―Whether to focus on ‘consolidating the core support base’ or ‘expanding the party’s appeal’ is also a key issue at the convention. In particular, it feels like the confrontation is growing larger after writer Yoo Si-min said President Lee Jae-myung’s ‘structural majority’ comment “will inevitably fail.” <<> “I think Yoo might have overexpressed it. He seems to have interpreted the President’s ‘structural majority’ comment as meaning an artificial restructuring of the political landscape (like in the past), but can we actually do an artificial political realignment by allying with people like Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon or Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok right now? After the insurrection, the People Power Party has actually become even more far-right. The President’s comment probably meant that continuing our centrist reformist and pragmatic approach and improving the people’s lives will ultimately lead to forming a majority. Of course, to achieve a structural majority, we must also continue the path of the grand democratic alliance.” <<> ―In the by-election for Pyeongtaek B district in Gyeonggi Province, the Democratic Party fielded a candidate simultaneously with the Rebuilding Korea Party. Hasn’t that made discussions on the grand democratic alliance and the merger of the two parties more difficult? <<> “In the last general election, the broader opposition, including the Democratic Party, secured a maximum of 192 seats. This was possible because we pursued the grand democratic alliance—‘let the party take the local districts and the proportional coalition take the proportional seats’—despite internal opposition. Because of this, we were able to lift the December 3 martial law and impeach (Yoon Suk-yeol). The grand democratic alliance is essential for winning the presidential election as well, and structuring the election in Pyeongtaek B so that both parties field candidates was a huge mistake. Some say it’s because the merger fell through before the election, but the ultimate responsibility lies with the party leader. Regardless, the issue of merging with the Rebuilding Korea Party must fully reflect the will of members from both sides. There are ways to work together: merger, electoral alliance, or policy coalition. We need to listen carefully to the members and choose which method is best. But we must never lose sight of the grand democratic alliance perspective.” <<> <<> ―There’s also criticism that “young people in their 20s and 30s are turning away from the Democratic Party.” <<> “First, diagnosing (the reason) as ‘young people have become conservative’ is wrong. How would you explain the young people in Daegu, a conservative area, who voted for candidate Kim Boo-kyum? Young people have a huge anxiety about the future. Polarization in our society is intensifying recently, and among the youth, the problem is even more severe. Just looking at the asset gap right now, the largest gap between the top 20% and bottom 20% is among the youth. (The fact that young people are leaving the Democratic Party) I see as them raising an issue about this. It’s not just about listening to their voices; we need to present solutions.” <<> ―During the process of setting the convention rules, the introduction of an elected youth supreme council member position fell through. Young candidates in the convention are also criticizing it as ‘vested-interest politics’ and demanding generational change. <<> “Creating a foundation for younger generations to actively engage in the party is important. In that sense, having party members elect a youth supreme council member provides (an important channel for) elevating youth. Defeating that motion really showed the party as a vested-interest party, a truly ‘old-school’ party. It’s truly shameful. However, generational change isn’t unconditionally right. We need to create a framework that can unite the people across old, middle-aged, and young generations. More importantly, the party must decide on its overall line—what efforts it will make to realize a democracy proven through the people’s lives.” <<> ―What direction should the Democratic Party’s line take? <<> “I hear people saying they don’t know who the Democratic Party is for. Some call it ‘the party for wealthy leftists in Gangnam,’ while others say, ‘Looking at the party membership, isn’t it a party for people in their 50s?’ They say this because we haven’t shown our intended direction. We must clarify the party’s line and address youth issues within that framework. The party’s overall line should prioritize people’s livelihoods. In particular, if the current government is focusing on expanding the future pie through economic growth policies aligned with the era of change, like AI technology development, then the party should focus on devising measures to ensure the people are not left behind and can thrive equitably in that process. If we fail to handle these issues properly, polarization could become extremely severe by the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election. The people can only feel at ease if we make overcoming the increasingly severe asset imbalance and polarization a major party line and focus on discussing solutions intensively.” <<> ―While serving as a Democratic Party lawmaker, was there a ‘moment in politics’ where you thought, ‘We handled that well,’ or that this is the direction to keep going? <<> “The moment I was most proud of as a Democratic Party lawmaker was when we created the Euljiro Committee in 2013 and carried out its activities. Politics must be ‘the weapon of the weak.’ That was exactly the slogan of the Euljiro Committee. As soon as I became a supreme council member in 2013, I went to the field, saw the tears of the so-called ‘Eul’s (weaker parties), and to represent their interests, I went around fighting against the ‘Gap’s (stronger parties).’ While balancing (the unfair Gap-Eul relationship), I felt proud, thinking, ‘Ah, this is the Democratic Party I wanted to be a part of.’ In this recent ‘Homeplus crisis,’ Euljiro Committee Chair Min Byung-deog worked very hard. Initially, MBK Partners, the majority shareholder, and Meritz Financial Group, the largest creditor, had no regard for the livelihoods of 100,000 people (including Homeplus workers, tenant businesses, and supplier partners) and were only interested in quickly bankrupting Homeplus to sell its assets. But when the Democratic Party announced it would hold a Homeplus hearing, they finally came up with a solution, didn’t they? The Euljiro Committee’s activities should be made a major party policy and line. Only then will the people think, ‘Ah, democracy improves my life. I won’t suffer injustice and can be paid fairly for my work.’ I will continue to play that role.” <<> hongbyul@hani.co.kr ( 민주당 전대 후보 등록이 시작된 지난 16일 국회 의원회관에서 만난 우 의원은 “그 어느 때보다 답답하고 무거운 심정”이라고 했다. “불법 비상계엄, 내란이라는 죽을 고비를 국민과 함께 넘기고 이재명 정부가 들어선 지 이제 고작 1년”인데, 서로에게 멸칭을 쓰며 ‘명청대전’이라는 말이 나올 정도로 “내부가 갈라져 권력투쟁을 하는 듯한 모습만 보여주고 있어서”다. 그는 “지금 민주당이 누구를 위한 정당인지를 잘 모르겠다는 말이 나온다”며 “국민들 실망이 커져 (정권 재창출에) 실패하면 다시는 민주 정부를 만들지 못하게 될지도 모른다는 위기감이 든다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Bo-mi: “Democratic Party must stop ‘lineage disputes’ and pursue ‘generational shift in power’” (김보미 “민주당, 족보 논쟁 멈추고 ‘권한의 세대교체’ 해야”)
item.description:
“We need a ‘generational shift in power’ where young people can actually exercise decision-making authority. If we keep digging into lineages, engaging in factional and orthodox lineage disputes, and only talking about the past, the Democratic Party will perish. We must transform into a party with a blueprint for the future.” (“청년이 실제로 결정권을 행사할 수 있는 ‘권한의 세대교체’를 해야 한다. 이대로 족보 캐고 계파·적통 논쟁하며 과거 얘기만 하면 민주당은 망한다. 미래의 설계도를 가진 정당으로 탈바꿈해야 한다.”)

Kim Bo-mi (37), the only candidate in her 30s in the race for party leader in the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 national convention, emphasized ‘generational shift’ and ‘the future’ in an interview with The Hankyoreh on the 21st. Born in Gangjin County, South Jeolla Province, Kim was elected as the first and youngest female county councilor in Gangjin in the 2018 local elections, and after winning reelection in 2022, served as the youngest chair of a local council in the country. ( 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 후보 중 유일한 30대인 김보미(37) 후보는 21일 한겨레와 한 인터뷰에서 ‘세대교체’와 ‘미래’를 강조했다. 전남광주통합특별시 강진군 출신인 김 후보는 2018년 지방선거에서 최초·최연소 여성 강진군의원으로 당선된 뒤 2022년 재선에 성공해 전국 최연소 기초의회 의장을 지냈다.)

– You strongly criticized the party over the ‘scrapped introduction of an elected youth supreme council member system’ and the ‘controversy over raising candidate deposits for the primary.’ ( ―‘선출직 청년 최고위원제 도입 무산’, ‘경선 후보 기탁금 인상 논란’을 두고 당을 강하게 비판했다.)

“Isn’t this the party’s true feelings (toward youth)? So far, they’ve only used (youth) and made them window dressing. The three candidates who have been in politics for a long time and served in leadership (Kim Min-seok, Cheong Cheong-rae, Song Young-gil) say they will introduce a youth supreme council member system if elected, but I can’t trust them. If I become party leader, I will eliminate the deposit barriers and propose the youth supreme council member system as the first agenda item on the day of my inauguration. The constantly changing primary rules are also a problem. I will change this situation where nothing obvious or basic is being observed.” ( “이게 (청년을 향한) 이 당의 진심이 아닐까. 지금까지 (청년을) 이용만 하고 들러리만 세웠다. 정치 오래하고 지도부도 하셨던 세분 후보(김민석·정청래·송영길)가 당선되면 청년 최고위원제 도입하겠다고 하지만 믿을 수가 없다. 내가 당대표가 되면 기탁금 장벽을 없애고, 청년 최고위원제도 취임 당일 안건 1호로 발의할 것이다. 수시로 바뀌는 경선 룰도 문제다. 당연하고 기본적인 게 하나도 지켜지지 않는 상황을 제가 바꾸겠다.”)

– What is the specific vision for ‘generational shift’? ( ―‘세대교체’의 구체적인 그림은 무엇인가?)

“Everyone shouts about youth, but there are no youth in the party. In this era of calling for becoming one of the three major powers in AI, the ruling party should lead future agendas, but if that generation (the 386 generation) goes with a mindset of milking it as 686, 786, 886, 986, it will all fail. A major reform on the level of re-founding the party is needed. The vested interests must step aside, and the party should be newly structured around youth and experts from future generations. (Other candidates) say they’ll set up committees and appoint youth, but what’s the point? They don’t have any power. Instead of just coming up with slogan-driven or handout-based youth policies, we need to actually give young people ‘power.’ When elected, I will ensure that the party’s youth committee has decision-making authority over youth-related policies. A ‘youth employment guarantee system’ should also be introduced as a core party policy.” ( “모두가 청년을 외치지만 당에는 청년이 없다. 에이아이(AI·인공지능) 3대 강국을 외치는 시대에 여당이 미래 의제를 주도해야 하는데, 그 세대(386세대)가 686, 786, 886, 986까지 해먹겠다는 마인드로 가면 다 망한다. 재창당 수준의 대개혁이 있어야 한다. 기득권은 물러나고 청년과 미래 세대 전문가 중심으로 당을 새롭게 짜야 한다. (다른 후보들이) 위원회를 만들어서 청년을 임명하겠다고 하던데 그럼 뭐 하나, 권한이 없는데. 구호성·시혜성 청년정책만 낼 게 아니라 실제로 청년 당사자에게 ‘권한’을 줘야 한다. 당선되면 청년 관련 정책은 당 청년위가 결정권을 갖게 하겠다. ‘청년 취업 보장제’도 당의 핵심 정책으로 도입해야 한다.”)

– The national convention is overheating with disputes over ‘legitimacy’ and ‘personal politics.’ ( ―전당대회가 ‘정통성’, ‘자기 정치’ 논쟁으로 과열되고 있는데.)

“The president is running ahead with future agendas, but we’re not thinking about supporting and advancing them; instead, we’re holding onto the past, ‘digging up lineages,’ and fighting. The urgent issues of our livelihoods matter now, but we’re fussing over who is the orthodox successor. Youth have no interest. Who cares about debates on prosecutorial reform or supplementary investigative powers? The current competition at the national convention is too disconnected from the people’s lives.” ( “대통령은 미래 의제를 갖고 뛰고 있는데, 뒷받침해 나아갈 생각은 안 하고 과거만 붙잡고 ‘족보 캐기’ 하며 싸우고 있다. 당장 우리가 먹고사는 민생 의제가 중요한데, 적통이니 뭐니 하고 있다. 청년들은 관심 없다. 검찰개혁, 보완수사권 논쟁에도 누가 관심 있나. 지금 전당대회 경쟁은 국민의 삶과는 너무 괴리감이 있다.”)

– What is the role of the next ruling party leader? ( ―차기 여당 대표의 역할은?)

“The first duty is naturally the success of the Lee Jae-myung government and building the foundation for regaining power. We must become a ruling party that prepares future agendas one step ahead of the president. We shouldn’t blindly shield the president’s faults. A ruling party that only claps isolates the president. We must listen to the grassroots sentiment and convey it to the president. I will carry on the spirit of Kim Dae-jung and Roh Moo-hyun, who fought against the odds, and the orthodox lineage of that challenge.” ( “제1임무는 당연히 이재명 정부의 성공이고, 재집권의 토대를 만드는 것이다. 미래 의제를 대통령보다 한발 앞서 준비하는 여당이 돼야 한다. 대통령의 잘못을 무조건 감싸서도 안 된다. 박수만 치는 여당은 대통령을 고립시킨다. 바닥 민심을 경청해 대통령에게 전달해야 한다. 계란으로 바위 치기였던 김대중·노무현의 정신, 그 도전의 적통을 잇겠다.”)

– If you are not included in the final three for the main primary, what are your plans afterward? ( ―본경선 최종 3인에 포함되지 않을 경우, 이후 계획은?)

“Local lawmakers are the closest to the people. People speak most comfortably (to local lawmakers). When I convey these very obvious things (by running in the convention), everyone is astonished, but what I’m saying is really conveying the basics of the basics (of public sentiment). (Regardless of the convention outcome) I will persistently practice breaking the rock of vested interests.” ( “지역 의원이야말로 국민들과 가장 가깝다. 국민들이 (지역 의원에게) 가장 편하게 이야기한다. (전당대회에 출마해서 국민들의) 너무나 당연한 이야기들을 전달하는 데 다들 깜짝 놀라시는데, 제가 말하고 있는 건 정말 (민심의) 기본 중의 기본을 전달하는 것이다. (전대 결과와 상관없이) 기득권 바위 깨기를 꾸준히 실천하겠다.”)

Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [View Briefing] Yoo Si-min Targets the President Again on YouTube ([뷰리핑] 유시민, 유튜브서 또 대통령 겨냥)

item.title: Yoon's Office: "New Trump Tariffs Under Section 301 – Industry Minister, Trade Chief to Visit U.S. for Consultations" (청와대 “트럼프 301조 새 관세, 산업장관·통상교섭본부장 미국 방문해 협의”)
item.description:
The presidential office in Seoul stated that regarding the U.S. government's plan to impose new tariffs on dozens of countries, "The Minister of Industry and the Deputy Minister for Trade Negotiations, who will visit the U.S. this week, plan to consult on related matters with the U.S. Department of Commerce and the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR)." (청와대가 수십개국을 상대로 한 미국 정부의 새로운 관세 부과 방침과 관련해 “금주에 방미하는 산업부 장관, 통상교섭본부장이 관련 사항을 미 상무부, 미무역대표부(USTR)와 협의할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

The presidential office made this announcement through a press release on the 22nd. U.S. President Donald Trump's 10% 'global tariff,' imposed under reciprocal tariff policies, is set to expire on the 24th following a ruling by the U.S. Supreme Court that deemed such reciprocal tariffs unlawful. Accordingly, the Trump administration is reportedly preparing a new tariff imposition policy based on Section 301 of the Trade Act. The presidential office added, "The U.S. government has consistently stated its position of respecting the Korea-U.S. tariff agreement," and "As the expiration date of the global tariff imposition on July 24 approaches, the government is closely monitoring relevant developments." <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (청와대는 22일 언론 공지를 통해 이렇게 밝혔다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 미국 연방대법원의 상호관세 위법 판결로 그간 부과해온 10% ‘글로벌 관세’가 오는 24일 만료되면서, 무역법 301조에 기반한 새로운 관세 부과 방침을 준비 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 청와대는 “미국 정부는 그동안 한미 관세 합의를 존중하겠다는 입장을 표명해왔다”며 “7월24일로 글로벌 관세 부과 종료 시점이 다가오는 만큼 정부는 관련 동향을 기민하게 파악하고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae Recruits 'Youth Fellowship'... President Lee Says "No Fancy Career or Specs Needed" (청와대 ‘청년 펠로우십’ 모집…이 대통령 “거창한 경력·스펙 필요없다”)
item.description:
On the 22nd, President Lee Jae-myung announced the recruitment of the Cheong Wa Dae Youth Fellowship, stating, "We aim to invite you, the youth, not merely as subjects of policy, but as colleagues to ponder together and find answers together." (이재명 대통령이 22일 “청년 여러분을 단지 정책의 대상이 아니라 함께 고민하고 함께 답을 찾아가는 동료로 모시고자 한다”며 청와대 청년 펠로우십을 모집한다고 밝혔다.)

On Facebook that day, the President said, "If a policy affects the lives of youth, its starting point must also be the voices of youth," adding, "While the government is constantly contemplating more delicate and innovative measures, there are clear limitations in capturing all the realities you, the youth, face daily." (이 대통령은 이날 페이스북에 “청년의 삶에 영향을 미치는 정책이라면 그 출발 역시 청년의 목소리여야 한다”며 “정부 또한 더욱 섬세하고 획기적인 방안을 늘 고민하지만, 청년 여러분께서 매일 마주하는 현실을 모두 담아내기에는 분명 한계가 있다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

The President further stated, "A grand career or special specs are not necessary," and "Even a small question felt in daily life is fine, and thoughts like 'I wish it could change this way' are also fine. If you have the desire to create a better world, along with hope and responsibility for the future, that is enough." He added, "We want to see the world through the eyes of youth, talk about policy in the language of youth, and shape the future of the Republic of Korea together based on the experiences of youth," and "We look forward to the keen interest and participation of our youth." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “거창한 경력이나 특별한 스펙은 필요하지 않다”며 “일상에서 느낀 작은 의문도 좋고 ‘이렇게 바뀌면 좋겠다’는 생각도 좋다. 더 좋은 세상을 만들고 싶은 마음, 미래를 향한 희망과 책임감이 있다면 그것만으로 충분하다”고 말했다. 이어 “청년의 시선으로 세상을 바라보고, 청년의 언어로 정책을 이야기하며, 청년의 경험으로 대한민국의 미래를 함께 만들어 가고 싶다”며 “우리 청년 여러분의 많은 관심과 참여를 기대한다”고 덧붙였다.)

The recruitment for the 1st Cheong Wa Dae Youth Fellowship began on the 20th and will run until 6 PM on the 5th of next month. After the announcement of document screening results, the fellows will work from September 1st of this year to February 28th of next year. Eligible applicants are youth aged 19 to 34. (제1기 청와대 청년 펠로우십 모집은 지난 20일 시작돼 다음 달 5일 오후 6시까지 진행된다. 서류심사 결과 발표 등을 거쳐 오는 9월1일부터 내년 2월28일까지 근무하게 된다. 신청 대상은 만 19살 이상 34살 이하 청년이다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Byung-do: "Prosecutors Must Investigate Directly to Protect Victims? Looking at the Past, That's Not the Truth" (한병도 “검사가 직접 수사해야 피해자 보호? 과거사 보면 진실 아냐”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea and floor leader, said on the 22nd, "The Democratic Party will strengthen the right to request supplementary investigations, and clearly hold investigative agencies accountable to promptly and faithfully fulfill such requests." This signals the party's intention to fully abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority and instead empower the right to request such investigations. (한병도 더불어민주당 당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 “민주당은 보완수사 요구권을 실질화하고, 수사기관이 그 요구를 신속하고 충실하게 이행하도록 책임을 분명히 하겠다”고 22일 말했다. 검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하고 요구권을 실질화하겠다는 방침을 밝힌 것이다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Floor Leader Han stated, "'Prosecutors do not investigate' is both the starting point and the completion of the prosecution reform that separates investigation from indictment. There is no disagreement within the party on this core principle." Han added, "The discussion has sufficiently matured. Now is the time to unite the party's collective will." (한 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “‘검사는 수사하지 않는다’는 것이 수사와 기소를 분리하는 검찰개혁의 출발이자 완성이다. 이 대원칙에는 당내 어떠한 이견도 없다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. 한 원내대표는 “논의는 충분히 무르익었다”며 “이제 당의 총의를 하나로 모을 시점”이라고 했다.)

Han further said, "Differences in detailed perceptions should not shake the principle of separating investigation from indictment, nor serve as a means to revive the prosecution's investigative authority. There should only be intense debate to create a better system, such as methods of mutual checks and cooperation among investigative agencies and measures to protect victims." (한 원내대표는 “세부적인 인식의 차이가 수사와 기소의 분리라는 원칙을 흔들거나 검찰의 수사권을 되살리는 수단이 돼선 안 된다”며 “수사기관 간 상호 견제와 협력의 방식, 피해자 보호 대책 등 더 나은 제도를 만들기 위한 치열한 토론만이 있을 뿐”이라고 했다.)

Floor Leader Han remarked, "I have also listened carefully to the argument that supplementary investigation authority is needed to protect victims. I deeply sympathize with the urgent voices that not a single victim should be left behind in the gaps of the system." (한 원내대표는 “피해자 보호를 위해 보완수사권이 필요하다는 주장도 경청했다”며 “단 한 명의 피해자도 제도의 틈에 남겨져선 안 된다는 절박한 목소리에도 깊이 공감한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "That is precisely why victim protection should not be left to the goodwill or discretion of a specific agency. The claim that prosecutors must investigate directly to protect victims is not the truth when we look back at the dark history of the prosecution." (그는 이어 “그렇기에 더더욱 피해자 보호를 특정 기관의 선의나 재량에 맡겨선 안될 것”이라며 “검사가 직접 수사해야만 피해자를 보호할 수 있다는 주장은 지난 검찰의 어두운 과거사를 돌아보면 진실이 아님을 알 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Han stated, "The Democratic Party will strengthen the right to request supplementary investigations and clearly hold investigative agencies accountable to promptly and faithfully fulfill those requests. We will establish mechanisms for control and cooperation that fit the new criminal justice system." (한 원내대표는 “민주당은 보완수사요구권을 실질화하고, 수사기관이 그 요구를 신속하고 충실하게 이행하도록 책임을 분명히 하겠다”며 “새로운 형사사법체계에 맞는 통제와 협력의 장치를 세우겠다”고 했다.)

He added, "We will set up a cross-investigation system where the police and the Major Crimes Investigation Agency check each other, and strengthen investigation reviews and external oversight. We will also more robustly guarantee victims' rights to object, to access records, and to receive legal assistance." (이어 “경찰과 중수청(중대범죄수사청)이 서로를 견제하는 교차수사체계를 세우고 수사심의와 외부 감찰을 강화하겠다. 피해자의 이의신청권과 기록 열람권, 법률 조력을 받을 권리도 더욱 두텁게 보장하겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Koh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok on Yoo Si-min’s "Fish Market Rotten Smell" Comment: "Just Another Intellectual Changing Course" (김민석, 유시민 “어물전 썩은 내” 발언에…“지식인 변침일 뿐”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, countered author Yoo Si-min’s criticism of the ruling party, in which Yoo said, "If you leave a fish market alone, it’s bound to give off a rotten smell," by stating, "In the language of comrades, there are no words like ‘certain defeat’ or ‘rotten smell’." (김민석 더불어민주당 당대표 후보는 유시민 작가가 “어물전 내버려두면 썩은 내 풍기게 돼 있다”며 여권을 비판한 것에 대해 “동지의 언어에 ‘필패’, ‘썩은 내’라는 단어는 없다”고 반박했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 22nd, Kim said, "The false prophecies predicting certain defeat for the Lee Jae-myung government will fail this time too, just like their bogus predictions that Kim Dae-jung would fail." He added, "Politics that distorts and manipulates the president’s own voice and intentions, crossing the line of commentary, has even lost restraint and dignity," and dismissed Yoo, saying, "Broadly speaking, he’s just another intellectual changing course, like Kim Ji-ha, Cho Soon, or Lee Nak-yon." <<> Yoo appeared on the YouTube show "2-Minute News" the previous night and, while making remarks suggesting that the internal discord within the ruling camp over the prosecution reform process was due to President Lee Jae-myung, said, "Even the finest fish market selling high-quality fish is bound to smell fishy, and if left unchecked with no limits, every fish market is bound to give off a rotten smell." (김 후보는 22일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “이재명 정부의 필패를 예언하는 헛예언들은 김대중이 실패하리라던 그들의 엉터리 예언처럼 이번에도 필패할 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 김 후보는 그러면서 “대통령의 육성과 진심을 왜곡변조하며 평론의 선을 월경한 정치는 절제와 품격조차 놓았다”며 “(유 작가는) 크게 보면 김지하, 조순, 이낙연처럼 또 하나의 지식인 변침일 뿐”이라고 했다.)

Kim said, "The Democratic Party will prevail on both fronts, inside and outside the party," and addressed Yoo, saying, "We will treat the aggressiveness of a return to politics, stripped of the guise of commentary, as a different political opinion and respect it." He added, "If it serves as a backdrop for the Rebuilding Korea Party to strengthen its independent line, we’ll take that into account as well. The Democratic Party will reorganize itself, replace its leadership, and walk the great path befitting a centrist force for solidarity, integration, and expansion." <<> By Lee Ji-eun, reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (유 작가는 전날 밤 유튜브 방송 ‘2분뉴스’에 출연해 검찰개혁 추진 과정에서 벌어진 여권 내 혼선이 이재명 대통령 때문이라는 취지의 발언을 하면서 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 파는 어물전도 비린내가 나기 마련이고, 어떤 제한도 두지 않고 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 썩은 내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea to Skip ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting Again This Year, Likely Burdened by Nuclear and South China Sea Agenda (북, 올해도 아세안 외교장관회의 불참…핵·남중국해 의제에 부담 느낀 듯)
item.description:
North Korea appears set to miss the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF) in Manila, Philippines, for the second consecutive year following last year's absence. <<> On the second day of the ASEAN Regional Forum, July 22 (local time), it was reported that North Korea had not sent a delegation. There were expectations that Hong Kwang-il, North Korea's ambassador to Indonesia and ASEAN, who took office in April, might attend, but it seems the decision was made to skip the event. <<> The background of the absence is interpreted as a consideration that issues to be discussed at the forum, such as the denuclearization of North Korea or matters related to China, conflict with North Korea's stance. <<> The foreign ministers of South Korea, the United States, and Japan are scheduled to hold a meeting in Manila today to discuss strategies for cooperation on North Korea. Each year, South Korea and ASEAN countries release statements through the forum condemning North Korea's nuclear and missile developments and provocations, and urging peace on the Korean Peninsula, which has sometimes sparked backlash from North Korea. <<> Additionally, as the conflict between this year's chair, the Philippines, and China over the South China Sea emerges as a key agenda item at the forum, North Korea, which tends to take a conciliatory stance on China issues, may find it burdensome to express its position on such topics. A diplomatic source stated, "Given that the Philippines is also an ally of the United States, and the focus of the forum could shift to the South China Sea issue, North Korea appears to have decided not to attend based on multiple considerations." <<> Instead, North Korea seems to be focusing on bilateral diplomacy with Russia and China. North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui visited Russia on July 19, two days before the forum opened. Minister Choe paid a courtesy call to President Vladimir Putin and held talks with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, appearing to focus on strengthening North Korea-Russia cooperation. Meanwhile, with China, North Korea marked the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, with North Korean Premier Pak Thae-song visiting Beijing from July 10 to 12, followed by a return visit to Pyongyang on July 15 by Wang Huning, Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) and fourth-ranking leader in China, continuing high-level exchanges. <<> North Korea, which joined the forum in 2000, began lowering its representation level in 2019 after the second U.S.-North Korea summit, sending ambassadors stationed in the host country or the ASEAN representative office as chief delegates instead of the foreign minister. However, after skipping the forum for the first time last year when it was held in Malaysia, it has now been absent from the consultative body for two consecutive years. <<> Manila / Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (북한이 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 아세안지역안보포럼(ARF)에 지난해에 이어 올해도 참석하지 않을 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Presidential Office: "President Lee Will Not Collect Interest on 1.7 Billion Won Mortgage... Gift Tax to Be Handled" (청와대 “이 대통령, 아파트 17억 근저당 이자 안 받아…증여세 처리할 것”)
item.description:
Regarding the fact that President Lee Jae-myung did not collect interest while setting up a mortgage of 1.77 billion won with the buyer of the apartment he recently sold as the debtor, the Presidential Office stated on the 22nd, "The gift tax issue arising from the interest-free arrangement will be handled in accordance with relevant regulations." This appears to be a measure considering that, under tax law, if no interest is exchanged in financial transactions between third parties, it is considered a gift and may be subject to gift tax. <<> Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong of the Presidential Office appeared on the YouTube program 'Presidential Office Fact Mill' the same day and said, "When the payment of the remaining balance was deferred for several months, the amount became large, so the interest was considerable, but it has been confirmed that the interest will not be collected." In response to criticism from the People Power Party and others, such as Representative Jang Dong-hyuk stating, "Even between parents and children, an interest-free loan is considered an 'abnormal transaction' subject to tax investigation," the Presidential Office reiterated its position. <<> On the 14th, President Lee signed a sales contract for an apartment in Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, and set up a mortgage with a maximum bond amount of 1.77 billion won, designating the buyer as the debtor. According to the Presidential Office's explanation, this was because the buyer temporarily lacked funds to pay the full purchase price, so the payment was deferred for a certain period, and in lieu, a mortgage was established, but no interest was collected on it. <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 최근 매각한 아파트의 매수인을 채무자로 삼아 17억7천만원의 근저당권을 설정하면서 이자를 받지 않은 것에 대해, 청와대가 22일 “무이자에 따라 발생하는 증여세 문제는 관련 규정에 따라 처리될 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 세법상 타인 간 금전 거래에서 이자를 주고받지 않으면 증여로 간주돼 증여세가 과세될 수 있다는 점을 고려한 조처로 보인다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Medical Fees Must Be Rationalized… Strengthen State Responsibility for Public Healthcare" (이 대통령 “의료 수가 합리화해야…공공의료 국가책임 강화”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 22nd that “rationalizing the medical fee system is crucial” to address the gaps in public and essential medical care. (이재명 대통령이 22일 공공·필수의료 공백을 해소하기 위해 “의료 수가체계를 합리화하는 게 중요하다”고 말했다.)

During a ‘Regional, Essential, and Public Healthcare Roundtable’ held at the Blue House, President Lee said, “To expand public healthcare, we must clearly strengthen the responsibility of the national community.” He added, “I’ve come to think whether it’s truly effective to leave everything as a domain for individuals to earn money while demanding morality and public responsibility. We continue to review policies in the direction of strengthening government responsibility for public and essential medical issues.” (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 ‘지역·필수·공공의료 간담회’에서 “공공의료를 확장하려면 국가 공동체의 책임을 확실히 강화해야겠다”며 “개인이 돈을 버는 영역으로 다 남겨두고 거기에 도덕과 공적 책임을 요구하는 게 과연 유효한가라는 생각을 하게 됐다. 공공·필수의료 문제는 정부 책임을 강화하는 방향으로 정책 검토를 계속 하고 있다”고 말했다.)

In this context, President Lee shared a personal experience. (그러면서 이 대통령은 개인 경험을 공유했다.)

President Lee said, “I filed a damages lawsuit against an obstetrician. At that time, the newborn was nearly in a vegetative state, so the compensation amount was enormous.” He continued, “I won the case, but what crossed my mind was that if I had to do everything as per the textbook, it would be impossible with that money. There is a recognized fee schedule, but checking oxygen saturation every five minutes was just not feasible.” He added, “I thought, ‘Who would want to be an obstetrician?’ and eventually, over a decade later, that became reality. Even though I was arguing medical negligence in court, I felt the basic conditions to fulfill the duty of care weren’t in place. It seemed like it wasn’t right. I even thought, shouldn’t the state be the one compensating?” (이 대통령은 “제가 산부인과 의사를 상대로 손해배상 소송을 했는데, 당시 신생아가 거의 식물인간 상태였기 때문에 배상액도 엄청 많았다”며 “재판에서 이기긴 했는데, 그때 든 생각이 교과서에 있는 대로 다 하려면 이 돈으로 도저히 할 수가 없는데, 인정되는 수가가 있는데 5분 단위로 산소포화도 체크하고 할 수가 없었다”고 말했다. 이어 “산부인과 의사 안 하고 싶겠다는 생각이 들었는데, 결국 십수년이 돼서 현실이 되고 말았다”며 “제가 법정에서 의료과실을 주장하고 있긴 하지만, 주의의무를 지키기 위한 기본적 여건이 갖춰져 있나, 이건 아닌 것 같다. 오히려 국가가 배상해야 하는 것 아닌가는 생각을 했다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also addressed the difficulties of reform. He said, “Reform is not easy. You have to adjust existing interests, and such adjustments inevitably involve some parties losing out. In the process of understanding, persuading, and converging to reach a certain conclusion, very rough scenes often unfold.” He added, “However, reaching a certain agreement without doing that—by respectfully adjusting and cooperating—requires everyone’s effort and patience. Although it’s not entirely completed, the progress on issues like medical school quotas and securing public and regional essential medical care is a very desirable achievement.” He further noted, “We often imagine reform involving crying, fighting, noise, confrontation, and conflict. But I think this medical reform process has proven that we can sufficiently reach certain conclusions through dialogue and persuasion without resorting to those things.” (이 대통령은 개혁의 어려움에 대해서도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “개혁이라는 게 쉽지 않다”며 “기존에 있던 이해관계를 조정해야 하고, 이해관계 조정은 필수적으로 뺏기는 측이 있게 된다. 이 점을 서로 잘 이해하고, 설득하고 수렴해 일정한 결론에 이르는 과정에서 대체로 매우 난폭한 모습이 연출된다”고 말했다. 이어 “그러나 그렇게 하지 않고 원만하게 서로를 존중하고 조정하면서 일정한 합의에 이르는 건 모두의 노력과 인내가 필요하다”며 “전체가 완료된 건 아니지만 의대 정원 문제나 공공·지역 필수의료 확보 문제가 상당한 진척을 이루게 된 건 매우 바람직한 성과”라고 덧붙였다. 또 “우리가 개혁하면 울고, 싸우고, 시끄럽고 그 다음에 대결하고 대립하는 것들을 상정하는데, 그러지 않고도 대화와 설득을 통해 충분히 일정한 결론에 이르게 될 수 있다는 점을 이번 의료개혁 과정에서 증명했다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok's 'Shincheonji Interference' Claims... Jeong Cheong-rae Fires Back: "Hit-and-Run Bombing with No Basis" (김민석 ‘신천지 개입설’에…정청래 반격 “아니면 말고식 폭탄던지기”)
item.description:
<<>> Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention for party leader, pushed back against Kim Min-seok's allegations of "Shincheonji interference in the party convention," calling it "a hit-and-run bombing with no basis." ()

After a forum titled "In the Democratic Party, Embracing Youth! Connecting Labor" held at the National Assembly Members' Office Building on the 22nd, Jeong told reporters, "I wish he would present evidence for the Shincheonji interference claim." ( 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당 대표 경선에 출마한 정청래 후보가 김민석 후보가 제기한 ‘신천지 전당대회 개입설’과 관련해 “아니면 말고식, 치고 빠지기식 폭탄 던지기”라며 반발했다.)

Jeong further stated, "Instead of creating smoke screens and later backtracking, he should clearly reveal, based on the five Ws and one H, how Shincheonji is interfering and getting involved in the Democratic Party's convention." ( 정 후보는 22일 국회 의원회관에서 열린 ‘인(in) 민주당 청년을 담다! 노동을 잇다’ 토론회를 마친 뒤 취재진을 만나 “신천지 개입을 근거를 갖고 말했으면 좋겠다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Candidates from Jeong's camp running for the Supreme Council—Lee Seong-yoon, Choi Min-hee, and Han Min-soo—also held a press conference at the National Assembly, demanding Kim reveal his evidence and calling for his withdrawal as a party leader candidate. ( 정 후보는 “연막 피우고 연기 피우고 나중에 발뺌하는 식이 아니라 정확하게 육하원칙에 의해서 신천지가 민주당 전당대회에 어떻게 개입하고 관여하고 있는지 육하원칙에 의해 밝혀달라”고 했다.)

Han said, "Kim's baseless claims are tantamount to saying that the Democratic Party itself should be subject to investigation," adding, "He is dragging our party, which he belongs to, into being labeled as an unconstitutional party violating the separation of church and state, just to gain an advantage in his own election." Lee added, "If he cannot provide evidence, we demand that Kim apologize to the Democratic Party and its members and resign as a party leader candidate." ( 최고위원 선거에 출마한 정 후보 쪽 이성윤·최민희·한민수 후보도 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “근거를 공개하라”며 김 후보의 당대표 후보직 사퇴를 촉구했다. )

Meanwhile, in his meeting with reporters, Jeong claimed, "According to a Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) poll, I have taken the lead in the Honam region by a wide margin," describing it as "the public's expression of opinion against 'you're not it.'" ( 한 후보는 “김 후보의 근거 없는 주장은 민주당 또한 수사 대상이 되어야 한다는 말이나 다름없다”며 “본인 선거에서 유리하자고 자신이 몸담고 있는 우리 당을 헌법상 정교분리를 위반한 위헌 정당으로 몰아가고 있다”고 했다. 이 후보도 “근거를 제시하지 못하면 김 후보는 민주당과 당원들에게 사과하고 당대표 후보를 사퇴할 것을 요구한다”고 했다. )

A KSOI survey conducted on the 20th and 21st via automated response (ARS) among 1,000 adults aged 18 and older nationwide found Jeong at 25.7%, Kim at 21.5%, and Song Young-gil at 8.3% in terms of suitability for the Democratic Party leadership. In the Gwangju and Jeolla region, where about one-third of the party's paid members are concentrated, Jeong scored 34.0%, Kim 23.1%, and Song 18.5%. The survey's margin of error is ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 5.4%. Details are available on the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. ( 한편, 정 후보는 이날 취재진과 만난 자리에서 “한국사회여론연구소(KSOI) 여론 조사상 호남에서 제가 많이 앞서는 거로 역전됐다”며 “‘넌 아니야'에 대한 대중들의 의사 표현”이라고 주장했다. )

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 한국사회여론연구소가 20~21일 전국 만 18세 이상 1000명을 대상으로 자동응답(ARS)을 통해 민주당 당대표 적합도를 조사한 결과를 보면, 정 후보 25.7%, 김 후보 21.5%, 송영길 후보 8.3%였다. 민주당 권리당원의 3분의 1가량이 모여있는 광주·전라 지역에선 정 후보가 34.0%, 김 후보가 23.1%, 송 후보가 18.5%였다. 이 여론조사의 표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 응답률은 5.4%다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다. )

item.title: Chung Dong-young "Expects Pope's Visit Next Year to Serve as an Opportunity for Inter-Korean Connection"… Yoo Heung-sik "There Will Be a Role" (정동영 “내년 교황 방한, 남북 연결 계기 기대”…유흥식 “역할 있을 것”)
item.description:
Unification Minister Chung Dong-young met with Cardinal Yoo Heung-sik, Prefect of the Dicastery for the Clergy of the Holy See, on the 22nd and stated, "The Korean Peninsula has been cut off from contact, dialogue, and meetings for the past 7-8 years. I expect that the Pope's visit to Korea will serve as an opportunity to build a bridge." (정동영 통일부 장관은 22일 교황청 성직자부 장관인 유흥식 추기경을 만나 “한반도가 지난 7~8년 동안 접촉과 대화가, 만남이 끊어져 있는 상황인데 교황께서 (한국에) 오심으로써 그 다리를 놓는 계기가 되리라고 기대한다”고 말했다.)

During a luncheon meeting with Cardinal Yoo at a restaurant in Jung-gu, Seoul, Minister Chung said that just as Pope Francis's visit to Korea in 2014 brought great consolation to a nation suffering from the Sewol Ferry disaster, Pope Leo XIV's visit to Korea next year will be a great blessing for peace on the Korean Peninsula. Pope Leo XIV is scheduled to visit Korea next year on the occasion of the Catholic World Youth Day, which will be held in South Korea in August. (정 장관은 이날 서울 중구 한 식당에서 유 추기경과 오찬간담회를 하면서 2014년 프란치스코 교황이 한국을 방문해 세월호 참사로 고통에 빠진 한국에 큰 위로가 됐듯이 레오 14세 교황의 내년 방한이 한반도 평화의 큰 축복이 될 것이라며 이렇게 말했다. 레오 14세 교황은 내년 8월 한국에서 열리는 천주교 세계청년대회 계기에 방한할 예정이다.)

Minister Chung expressed, "Beyond political significance, I hope that young people from the North can also participate in this gathering of global youth," and added, "I will work hard to restore trust between the two Koreas before the Pope's visit and will do my best to ensure the World Youth Day is successfully held in a positive atmosphere." (정 장관은 “정치적인 의미를 떠나 세계 청소년들이 모이는 데 북쪽의 청소년들도 함께 참석할 수 있게 되기를 소망한다”며 “교황 방한 전까지 열심히 남북 간 신뢰 회복을 위해 노력하고 좋은 분위기 속에 세계청년대회가 성공적으로 되도록 잘 돕겠다”고 말했다.)

Cardinal Yoo explained that Apostolic Nunciatures in various countries operate according to local conditions, including contacting local North Korean embassies in line with the Pope's schedule and messages. He emphasized, "(The Pope) will visit (Korea) from August 3rd to 8th next year. As the Holy See, there will be such roles, and there is no doubt that efforts will be made." (유 추기경은 각국에 있는 교황청대사관이 교황의 일정과 메시지에 따라 현지의 북한대사관과 접촉하는 등 주재 지역의 여건에 맞게 활동을 펼친다고 설명하면서 “(교황께서) 내년 8월3일부터 8일까지 (한국을) 방문하시는데 교황청으로서는 다 그러한 역할이 있을 것이고, 노력하는 것은 틀림없다”고 강조했다.)

At the meeting, Cardinal Yoo shared that when he proposed to Pope Francis several years ago that Korea host the World Youth Day, he cited the division of the Korean Peninsula as the primary reason. He said, "I explained to the Pope that if young people vividly experience division and peace along the 155-mile demilitarized zone (DMZ) armistice line and form a human chain, 300,000 to 350,000 people could connect from east to west." He added, "I told him that it would be tremendously meaningful if young people gathered in Korea, reflecting on the spirit of martyrdom and practicing peace and harmony." Upon hearing this, Pope Francis reportedly said, "Then pray a lot." (이날 간담회에서 유 추기경은 몇 년 전 프란치스코 교황에게 한국에서 세계청년대회를 개최하자고 제안하며 한반도의 분단을 그 첫째 이유로 꼽았다고 소개했다. 그는 “젊은이들이 비무장지대(DMZ) 휴전선 155마일을 따라 분단, 평화를 생생하게 경험하며 인간 띠를 잇는다고 하면, 30만~35만명이면 동에서 서까지 연결할 수 있다고 교황께 설명해 드렸다”며 “젊은이들이 순교 정신을 되새기고 평화와 화합을 실천하며 한국에 모인다면 엄청난 의미가 있다고 말씀드렸다”고 했다. 이 이야기를 들은 프란치스코 교황은 “그러면 기도 많이 하세요”라고 말했다고 한다.)

Cardinal Yoo also mentioned that during a meeting of the College of Cardinals just before his return to Korea, Pope Leo XIV asked whether President Lee Jae-myung enjoyed his visit to the Vatican. Cardinal Yoo replied, "President Lee was very pleased and felt much love (apparently)." The Pope then said he too was "very happy and asked to convey his special regards." (유 추기경은 이번 귀국 직전 참석한 추기경단 회의에서 레오 14세 교황이 이재명 대통령이 바티칸 방문을 좋아했는지를 질문했다면서, 자신이 “이 대통령이 많이 기뻐했고 많은 사랑을 느끼고 갔다(고 한다)”고 답하자 교황도 “아주 기뻤으며 교황의 특별한 인사를 전해달라”고 했다고 전했다.)

item.title: Park Ji-won: "Is Oh Se-hoon Making Jang Dong-hyuk's Dream of a By-election Come True?" (박지원 “장동혁 재선거 꿈, 오세훈이 이뤄주나”)
item.description:
When Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon received a fine of 10 million won in the first trial on the 22nd for suspicions that he received poll results from 'political broker' Myung Tae-kyun and had a supporter pay the cost on his behalf, Park Ji-won, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, sarcastically remarked, "Mayor Oh is making Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's (of the People Power Party) dream of a by-election come true." If the first trial sentence is finalized, Mayor Oh will lose his position as mayor. (‘정치 브로커’ 명태균씨로부터 여론조사 결과를 받고 그 비용을 후원자에게 대신 내게 한 의혹을 받는 오세훈 서울시장이 22일 1심에서 벌금 1000만원을 선고받자 박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 “장동혁 (국민의힘) 대표의 재선거 꿈을 오 시장이 이루어 준다”고 비꼬았다. 1심 형량이 확정되면 오 시장은 시장직을 잃는다.)

Lawmaker Park wrote on Facebook that day, "Dreams come true. Ironically, Mayor Oh is making Representative Jang's dream of a by-election come true. Mayor Oh, who lied without batting an eye as the mayor of Seoul, the capital of South Korea, home to 10 million citizens! The path to atonement is to give up the appeal, pay the 10 million won fine, and perhaps take a ride on the Han River bus." (박 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “꿈은 이루어진다. 장 대표의 재선거 꿈을 아이러니하게도 오 시장이 이루어 준다”며 “대한민국 수도 1000만 시민의 서울시장으로 눈 하나 깜짝 않고 거짓말한 오 시장! 속죄의 길은 항소 포기하고 1000만원 벌금 납부하고 한강버스나 한번 타보시길 바란다”고 말했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Park Joo-min argued on Facebook that day, "Oh Se-hoon is not qualified to be mayor. There is no place for a lying mayor in Seoul. However, the fine of 10 million won is light compared to the weight of the crime. The appellate court should make a stricter judgment." He added, "The trial deadlines set by the special prosecution law must be strictly observed. The appeal and final appeal should each be concluded within three months. No further delays can be tolerated." (박주민 민주당 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “오세훈은 시장 자격이 없다. 서울에 거짓 시장이 설 자리는 없다”며 “다만, 벌금 1000만원은 죄의 무게에 비해 가볍다. 항소심은 더 엄중히 판단해야 한다”고 주장했다. 이어 “특검법이 정한 재판 기일을 반드시 지켜야 한다”며 “항소심·상고심은 각 3개월 이내다. 더 이상의 지연은 용납될 수 없다”고 했다.)

Park Eun-jung, a lawmaker of the Rebuilding Korea Party, also called for a swift trial. She wrote on Facebook that day, "With today's first trial ruling, a path has opened for citizens to once again judge the reckless administration of Seoul, which had abandoned the safety of citizens threatened by the shoddy construction of the GTX (Great Train Express) and the Han River bus that has turned into a tourist boat." She added, "It is now the turn of Justice Cho Hee-dae's judiciary to respond to the citizens' demands." She further argued, "The Supreme Court should properly confirm Oh Se-hoon's illegal poll cost payment charges as a disqualifying sentence by February next year." <<> Calls for "Immediate resignation of Mayor Oh" also emerged. Lim Myung-hee, spokesperson for the Rebuilding Korea Party, said in a commentary released that day, "Mayor Oh has been claiming his innocence. As a public official serving a fifth term as Seoul mayor, he has been brazenly lying to the entire nation all along." She urged, "Mayor Oh Se-hoon should stop deceiving citizens with meaningless delays and resign immediately. The only remaining duty for Mayor Oh to the people and Seoul citizens is to normalize Seoul's administration as soon as possible." (박은정 조국혁신당 의원도 빠른 재판 진행을 촉구했다. 그는 이날 페이스북에서 “오늘 1심 판결로써 순살 GTX(수도권광역급행철도) 시공과 유람선으로 전락한 한강버스로 위협받는 시민들의 안전을 내팽개치며, 방만했던 서울 시정에 대해 시민들이 다시 심판할 수 있는 길이 열렸다”며 “조희대 사법부가 시민들의 요구에 응답할 차례”라고 했다. 이어 “대법원은 내년 2월 전까지 오세훈의 불법 여론조사 대납 혐의를 당선무효형으로 확정해야 마땅하다”고 주장했다.)

The Criminal Division 22 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Jo Hyeong-woo) sentenced Mayor Oh to a fine of 10 million won on the 22nd for violating the Political Funds Act. Mayor Oh was put on trial for receiving poll results from Mr. Myung a total of 10 times (3 publicly announced, 7 not publicly announced) ahead of the April 7 Seoul mayoral by-election in 2021, and having Kang Cheol-won, former deputy mayor for political affairs of Seoul, arrange for supporter Kim Han-jung to pay around 33 million won in costs on his behalf. The court determined that 21 million won of this constituted the illegal payment of poll costs. (‘오 시장 즉각 사퇴’ 주장도 나왔다. 임명희 조국혁신당 대변인은 이날 낸 논평에서 “그동안 오 시장은 결백을 주장했다. 5선 서울시장이라는 공직자 신분으로 전 국민 앞에서 시종일관 뻔뻔하게 거짓말한 것”이라며 “오세훈 시장은 더 이상 무의미한 시간 끌기로 시민들을 기만하지 말고, 즉각 사퇴하라”고 촉구했다. “하루빨리 서울시정을 정상화하는 것만이, 오 시장이 국민과 서울 시민에게 할 수 있는 마지막 도리”라는 것이다.)

Reporter Jeon Kwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (서울중앙지법 형사22부(재판장 조형우)는 이날 정치자금법 위반 혐의를 받는 오 시장에게 벌금 1000만원을 선고했다. 오 시장은 2021년 4·7 서울시장 보궐선거를 앞두고 명씨로부터 총 10차례(공표 3회·비공표 7회)에 걸쳐 여론조사 결과를 받고, 강철원 전 서울시 정무부시장을 통해 후원자 김한정씨에게 3300만원 상당의 비용을 대신 내게 한 혐의로 재판을 받고 있다. 재판부는 이 중 2100만원이 여론조사 비용 대납에 해당한다고 봤다.)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae on ‘5·18 Sanctuary’: “President Lee Created the Conditions for the Baejae High School Incident” (‘5·18 성역’ 이병태 “배재고 사태, 이 대통령이 원인 제공”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae, the former vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Reform who resigned after sparking controversy by claiming that “the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement has become a sanctuary,” has asserted that “President Lee Jae-myung is the one who caused the Baejae High School incident.” (“5·18이 성역이 됐다”는 발언으로 논란을 일으킨 뒤 사퇴한 이병태 전 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 “배재고 사태의 원인 제공자는 이재명 대통령”이라고 주장했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 22nd, the former vice-chairman said, “Why did I argue that Gwangju has been turned into a sanctuary? Because people and authorities who seek to monopolize the political symbolism and meaning of certain events—like historical incidents or the Sewol ferry disaster—use it as a marker of partisan politics to stigmatize and character-assassinate their opponents.” (이 전 부위원장은 22일 페이스북에서 “나는 광주가 왜 성역화되었다고 항변했는가”라며 “역사와 세월호 사고 등 특정 사건의 정치적 상징성과 의미를 독점하려는 사람들과 권력이 상대를 낙인찍고 인격 살인하는 진영 정치의 표식으로 삼고 있기 때문”이라고 말했다.)

Pointing to President Lee as the cause of the “Baejae High School incident,” he claimed, “This whole issue started and ended when he, with an irresponsible and conspiratorial perspective, posted a thoughtless comment late at night on social media, framing Starbucks Korea’s marketing as a mockery of unfortunate events from the past democratization process.” (이어 이 대통령을 ‘배재고 사태’의 원인으로 들며 “그가 무책임한 음모론적 시각으로 에스엔에스(SNS)에 스타벅스 코리아 마케팅을 과거 민주화 과정의 불행한 사건들을 조롱하는 것으로 한밤중에 생각 없는 글을 올린 것이 이 문제의 시작이자 전부”라고 주장했다.)

The former vice-chairman added, “This is a case of national conflict sparked by the arrogance of a power-holder who appointed themselves as a judge of history. I conveyed to the (presidential) secretary for national unity that the president should apologize. I don’t know if that message was passed along, but the one who caused it is still playing innocent.” (이 전 부위원장은 “권력자의 역사 심판관을 자처한 오만이 부른 국민 갈등의 사례”라며 “나는 (청와대) 국민통합비서관에게 대통령이 사과해야 한다는 뜻을 전했다. 그 말이 전달되었는지 모르지만 원인 제공자는 지금까지 시치미를 떼고 있다”고 했다.)

He also said, “I will keep asking: Who caused the conflict between Honam and non-Honam regions through partisan politics? Is it Lee Byung-tae or President Lee Jae-myung?” (또 “앞으로도 계속 물을 것이다”라며 “진영 정치로 호남과 비호남의 갈등을 부른 원인 제공을 누가 했는가? 이병태인가 이재명 대통령인가”라고도 했다.)

The former vice-chairman ignited controversy on the 2nd in a Facebook post related to the disciplinary action against students from Seoul’s Baejae High School baseball team for what was called “hateful cheering about May 18.” He claimed that “May 18 has become a sanctuary in this land” and that it was “reminiscent of North Korea.” Despite a warning from the presidential office on the 4th calling his behavior “inappropriate,” he posted again reaffirming his stance. After the presidential office recommended his resignation on the 6th, he stepped down. (이 전 부위원장은 지난 2일 페이스북에 ‘5·18 혐오 응원’으로 서울 배재고 야구부 학생들이 징계를 받은 것과 관련해 “이 땅에 5·18이 성역이 된 것”, “북한의 모습”이라고 주장해 논란을 빚었다. 이에 청와대가 지난 4일 “부적절한 처신”이라며 경고했음에도 자신의 주장을 고수하는 글을 재차 올렸고, 지난 6일 청와대가 사퇴를 권고하자 물러났다.)

A professor emeritus at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), the former vice-chairman is a conservative figure who served as the head of the policy coordination office for candidate Hong Joon-pyo’s camp during last year’s People Power Party presidential primary. He was appointed in March as vice-chairman of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Reform, a position equivalent to a cabinet minister, under President Lee’s policy of inclusive personnel appointments. (한국과학기술원(KAIST) 명예교수인 이 전 부위원장은 지난해 국민의힘 대선 경선 당시 홍준표 후보 캠프 정책총괄본부장을 맡은 보수 출신 인사다. 이 대통령의 통합 인사 기조에 따라 지난 3월 총리급인 규제합리화위 부위원장에 임명된 바 있다.)

Song Kyung-hwa, Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "If 'New Lee Jae-myung' Becomes the Party Mainstream, I Think There Will Be Difficulties in General and Presidential Elections" (정청래 “‘뉴이재명’ 당 주류 되면 총선·대선 어려움 있겠다 생각해”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 22nd, "The so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' should become a plus alpha for the party, but if the major pillar collapses and those people become the party's mainstream, I thought there would be difficulties in many elections ahead." (정청래 더불어민주당 당대표 후보는 22일 “(이른바) ‘뉴이재명’이 (당의) 플러스 알파가 돼야 하는데, 큰 축이 무너지고 그런 분들이 당 주류가 된다면 앞으로 참 많은 선거에서 어려움이 있겠다고 생각했다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on SBS's "Joo Young-jin's News Briefing" that day, Candidate Jeong said, "After the June 3 local elections, I became aware that there is a movement among the Democratic Party's traditional support base and core group to leave en masse. I thought about how we could overcome general and presidential elections without the people who supported Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung sticking together—if the core base turns its back, how is this possible?" He indicated that he decided to run for reelection as party leader, believing that if the 'big pillar' of the traditional support base collapses and the 'New Lee Jae-myung' becomes the mainstream, winning the general and presidential elections would be difficult. <<> When asked about recent remarks by author Yoo Si-min, such as 'the administration is doomed to fail' and 'the leader of New Lee Jae-myung is President Lee,' Candidate Jeong replied, "I'll just say no comment. Sometimes, silence is better." The previous day, on the YouTube channel '2-Minute News,' Yoo criticized the ruling party's prosecutorial reform process as a mess and said, "I judged that the leader of the 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is likely President Lee Jae-myung." <<> Regarding his rival for party leadership, Candidate Kim Min-seok's claims of 'Shincheonji involvement,' Jeong said, "Regardless of the pros and cons in the party convention, one should provide exact explanations and, if there is evidence, request an investigation. Doing hit-and-run tactics by talking about vague things, raising suspicions, and passing the buck is unacceptable. If someone mentions my name and links me to such allegations, I will take legal action in the strongest way possible." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (정 후보는 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 주영진의 뉴스브리핑에 출연해 “6·3 지방선거 이후 민주당의 전통적 지지층, 핵심 코어층이 대거 이탈하려고 하는 움직임이 있다는 걸 알게 됐다. 김대중·노무현·문재인·이재명을 지지했던 사람들이 똘똘 뭉치지 않고 어떻게 총선·대선을 넘을 수 있는 것인가, 핵심 코어층이 등을 돌리면 어떻게 이게 가능한가 생각했다”며 이렇게 말했다. 전통적 지지층인 ‘큰 축’이 무너지고, ‘뉴이재명’이 주류가 되면 총선·대선 승리가 어렵다고 보고 당대표 연임에 나섰다는 것이다.)

item.title: President Lee Embarks on 7-Night, 11-Day Diplomatic Tour of US and South America… Series of Meetings with Big Tech CEOs including Jensen Huang (이 대통령, 미국·남미 7박11일 순방…젠슨 황 등 빅테크 CEO 연쇄 회동)
item.description:
The presidential office announced on the 22nd that President Lee Jae-myung will visit the United States and South American countries including Brazil from the 24th to August 3rd. (이재명 대통령이 24일부터 8월3일까지 미국과 브라질 등 남미를 방문한다고 청와대가 22일 밝혔다.)

National Security Advisor Wi Sung-lac stated at a briefing at the presidential office that day, “President Lee plans to visit San Francisco in the US, Brazil, Chile, and Argentina, and then return via Frankfurt, Germany.” (위성락 국가안보실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “이 대통령은 미국 샌프란시스코, 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나를 방문하고 독일 프랑크푸르트를 거쳐 귀국할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

First, on the 24th in San Francisco, he will sequentially meet with Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, Jensen Huang, CEO of NVIDIA, and Hock Tan, CEO of Broadcom. Afterwards, he will attend the AI Summit and announce the ‘San Francisco AI Declaration,’ expressing the will to leapfrog as an indispensable nation in the global AI ecosystem and outlining a vision for global cooperation. This event will be attended by approximately 150 people, including Lee Jae-yong, Chairman of Samsung Electronics, Chey Tae-won, Chairman of SK Group, along with domestic and international AI business figures, researchers, startups, and investors. On the 25th, he plans to meet with six top venture capital firms to discuss cooperation in the venture ecosystem. <<> Following this, at the invitation of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, he will make a state visit to Brazil from the 26th to the 29th. From the 29th to the 30th, he will officially visit Chile for a summit with President José Antonio Kast, and then make an official visit to Argentina for the first time in 22 years.
