item.title: Cheong Wa Dae: "Starting Point for Resolving Coupang Issue Differs from U.S.… Must Be Handled Through Law, Not Lobbying" (청 “쿠팡 문제 푸는 출발점, 미국과 차이…로비 아닌 법으로 다뤄야”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae said on the 22nd regarding the Coupang issue, "There appears to be a difference in the starting point for resolving the problem (compared to the U.S.)," adding, "We believe it should be handled fairly and non-discriminately according to legal procedures." (청와대가 22일 쿠팡 문제와 관련해 “문제를 푸는 출발점에서 (미국과) 차이가 있어 보인다”며 “법적 절차에 따라서 비차별적으로 공정하게 다뤄져야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

During a Cheong Wa Dae briefing on the same day, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated, "Among various Korea-U.S. issues, the biggest one is investment, and the next most significant matter can be seen as Coupang," adding, "This matter is being handled according to prescribed regulations and legal procedures. It is not being handled discriminately or targeted." (위성락 국가안보실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “한미 여러 현안 중 제일 큰 것은 투자고, 그 다음쯤되는 사안이 쿠팡이라고 보면 된다”며 “이 사안은 소정의 규제 및 법적 절차에 따라 다뤄지고 있다. 차별적으로 다루거나 표적해서 다루는 것은 아니다”라고 말했다.)

Director Wi said, "As the Personal Information Protection Commission investigated and announced, this is a major personal information leak, with the scale exceeding 33 million people. However, on the other side, some do not see it as 33 million but, based on what a 'suspect' said, claim it is 3,000 cases," adding, "This is a significant difference, and there is a gap in the starting point." He continued, "If this were the U.S., it would be like the personal information of 200 million people being leaked. If such a leak occurred nationwide and we didn't know where, it would not be a simple matter." (위 실장은 “개인정보보호위원회가 조사하고 발표했듯이 대형 (개인정보) 유출 사안이고, 유출 규모가 3300만명이 넘는다. 그런데 다른 쪽에서는 3300만명이라고 보지 않고 ‘피의자’가 한 얘기에 근거해 3000건으로 얘기하는 사람이 있다”며 “굉장히 큰 차이점이고, 출발점에서 차이가 있다”고 말했다. 이어 “미국으로 치면 2억 인구의 인적 정보가 유출됐다는 건데, 전국에서 유출됐고 (유출된 곳이) 어딘지를 모른다면 단순한 사안은 아니다”라고 했다.)

Director Wi further emphasized, "I believe the most important platform for handling this issue is through prescribed regulations and legal procedures, so it should be addressed there," adding, "If instead, activities like lobbying or other means outside this arena become dominant, it could undermine the proper functioning of existing legal procedures. Therefore, it must be handled fairly and non-discriminately according to legal procedures." (위 실장은 또 “이 문제를 다루는 가장 중요한 장은 소정의 규제와 법적 절차이기 때문에 거기서 다뤄져야 한다고 생각한다”며 “만약 그렇지 않고 장외에서 로비나 다른 방식으로 이뤄지는 일이 주가 되면, 원래 법적으로 존재하는 절차가 온당하지 않게 돌아갈 소지가 있기 때문에 법적 절차에 따라 비차별적으로 공정하게 다뤄져야 한다”고 강조했다.)

On the 1st (local time), the Republican side of the U.S. House Judiciary Committee released an interim investigation report claiming that the South Korean government had discriminately attacked U.S.-owned companies like Coupang, and a White House official also stated, "The Trump administration is deeply concerned about the South Korean government's discriminatory targeting of U.S. technology companies." In response to controversy over Coupang's lobbying activities, Coupang issued a statement on the 16th arguing, "Lobbying activities with the U.S. government and political circles are activities guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution and are the rights of responsible citizens in American society." (지난 1일(현지시각) 미국 하원 법사위원회 공화당 쪽이 한국 정부가 쿠팡 등 미국 소유 기업을 차별적으로 공격해왔다고 주장하는 중간 조사보고서를 공개했고, 미국 백악관 당국자도 “트럼프 행정부는 한국 정부가 미국 기술기업들을 차별적으로 표적 삼는 상황을 깊이 우려하고 있다”는 입장을 냈다. 쿠팡의 로비 활동이 논란이 되자 쿠팡은 지난 16일 입장을 내 “미국 정부와 정치권에 대한 로비 활동은 미국 헌법에 보장된 활동이고, 미국 사회에서 책임감 있는 시민의 권리”라고 주장했다.)

However, Director Wi stated that issues like Coupang do not affect security matters. He said, "Although there are various issues between Korea and the U.S., there are no signs that security consultations are being delayed (due to Coupang, etc.)." He added, "Such situations occurred in the past, but not now. Investment consultations are also being discussed, and I understand efforts are being made to achieve tangible outcomes." (위 실장은 그러나 쿠팡 등의 현안이 안보 현안에 영향을 끼치지 않는다고 밝혔다. 그는 “한미간 여러 현안이 있지만, (쿠팡 등으로) 안보 협의가 지연되는 조짐은 없다”며 “과거에는 그런 일이 있었지만, 지금은 그런 상황이 있지 않다. 투자 협의도 논의되고 있고, 성과물이 가시화되기 위한 노력을 하고 있는 것으로 안다”고 말했다.)

Additionally, regarding U.S. President Donald Trump's request for South Korea to build warships, Director Wi said, "It's not a detailed narrative but rather a few brief points, so it's not clear," adding, "However, there are indications that (Trump) may have in mind a new approach different from what we previously thought, so we are currently assessing it." Earlier last month, President Moon Jae-in revealed at the G7 summit in Évian, France, that President Trump asked, "Can you build 10 U.S. warships quickly?" (아울러 위 실장은 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 한국에 군함 건조를 요청한 것과 관련해 “정교한 내러티브라기보다 몇가기 짧게 제시한 것이기 때문에 분명치는 않다”면서도 “기존에 우리가 생각했던 것과는 다른 새로운 방안을 염두에 두는 듯한 정황이 있어 지금 파악 중”이라고 말했다. 앞서 이 대통령은 지난달 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의에서 트럼프 대통령이 “미국 군함 10척을 신속히 건조할 수 있느냐”고 물은 사실을 공개한 바 있다.)

Meanwhile, regarding heightened tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, Director Wi said, "There were no new requests (from the U.S. side related to military contributions)." He stated, "South Korea's dependence on crude oil from the Strait of Hormuz is among the highest in the world," adding, "From a security perspective, free navigation in the Strait of Hormuz is not someone else's issue but is directly linked to our security, so we have always participated in discussions with the stance of actively making practical contributions." He continued, "Consultations with the U.S., the U.K., and France have been ongoing," and added, "While there were no specific requests from the U.S. side for warships, we have maintained a position of making practical contributions, and we are working to do so by comprehensively considering domestic legal procedures, legal aspects, and policy considerations." (한편 위 실장은 호르무즈해협의 긴장감이 높아지는 것과 관련해 “(군사적 기여와 관련한 미국 쪽의) 새로운 요청은 없었다”고 말했다. 그는 “우리나라는 호르무즈해협 원유 의존도가 전세계에서 손꼽는 정도로 높은 나라”라며 “안보 측면에서 호르무즈 자유 통항은 남의 일이 아니라 (우리 안보와) 직결된 문제여서 언제나 동참하고 실질적인 기여를 적극적으로 하겠다는 입장으로 논의에 임해왔다”고 했다. 이어 “미국과 영국, 프랑스 등과의 협의는 기존부터 쭉 있었던 것”이라며 “미측으로부터 군함 등 구체적인 요구가 있었던 것은 아니지만 실질적인 기여를 하겠다는 입장으로 임해왔기 때문에 국내법 절차, 법적 측면, 정책적 측면 등을 종합적으로 보고 실질적인 기여를 하려는 노력으로 임하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: As Jang Dong-hyuk 'Holds On,' Internal Pressure Mounts in People Power Party to 'Abolish Party Leader Role, Separate Candidate Nomination Power' (장동혁 ‘버티기’에 국힘 내부서 ‘당대표 폐지·공천권 분리’ 압박 목소리)
item.description:
Within the People Power Party (PPP), reform proposals to reduce or abolish the party leader's role are being presented one after another. Amid the prolonged internal conflict over the status of leader Jang Dong-hyuk, this is seen as a move to pressure Jang, who has opted to 'hold on.' (국민의힘에서 당 대표 역할을 축소하거나 폐지하는 개혁안이 잇따라 제시되고 있다. 장동혁 대표의 거취 문제를 둘러싼 당내 갈등이 장기화하는 가운데, ‘버티기’에 나선 장 대표를 압박하기 위한 포석으로 풀이된다.)

The 'Alternatives and Future' group, a gathering of young PPP lawmakers, exchanged opinions on conservative expansion strategies during a breakfast meeting on the 22nd. Choi Hyung-du, a lawmaker who led the discussion, argued, "The structural crisis of Korean political parties lies in the imperial party leader system and winner-takes-all dynamics," adding, "The fundamental issue is a power structure where candidate nomination rights, personnel authority, party management rights, and message control are excessively concentrated in the party leader." Choi emphasized that completely separating candidate nomination power from the party leader is a key reform task. (국민의힘 소장파 의원 모임 ‘대안과 미래’는 22일 조찬 모임에서 보수 확장 전략을 주제로 의견을 나눴다. 발제에 나선 최형두 의원은 “한국 정당의 구조적 위기는 제왕적 당대표 체제와 승자독식”이라며 “공천권, 인사권, 당무운영권, 메시지 통제권이 당대표에게 과도하게 집중된 권력 구조가 문제의 본질”이라고 주장했다. 최 의원은 당대표에게서 공천권을 완전히 분리하는 것이 정당 혁신의 핵심 추진 과제라고 강조했다.)

Lee Seong-kwon, a lawmaker serving as the secretary of 'Alternatives and Future,' later told reporters, "During today's discussion, there was much awareness about whether a structure reliant only on fan bases and hardline supporters helps transition to a national party, or rather acts as an obstacle." This was interpreted as a remark targeting Jang's actions, which have focused on rallying hardline supporters following incidents like the ballot shortage in the June 3 local elections. (대안과 미래 간사인 이성권 의원은 이후 기자들과 만나 “오늘 토론 중에는 팬덤층과 강성 지지층에만 의존하는 구조가 국민 정당으로 가는 데 도움이 되나, 오히려 장애물이 되는 것 아니냐는 (문제)의식이 많이 나왔다”고 말했다. 이는 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등을 계기로 강성 지지층 결집에 골몰하고 있는 장 대표 행보를 겨냥한 발언으로 해석됐다.)

Skepticism toward the party leader system is emerging in various quarters, coinciding with Jang's weakened position. Lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun, after a breakfast meeting with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon the previous day, stated, "Mayor Oh suggested abolishing the party leader role, returning to a parliamentary party system, and institutionalizing public candidate nominations," adding, "I will try to gather voices within the assembly." During a lecture at the National Assembly last month, Mayor Oh cited the U.S. Congress as an example, saying, "Do we really need a party leader? The party can be sufficiently run with just the floor leader." Lawmaker Joo Ho-young recently mentioned to a media outlet, "Isn't it time for a collective leadership system?" However, pro-leader Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won appeared on YTN Radio's 'Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang' that day to counter these ideas as "lacking feasibility." (당대표 체제 회의론은 장 대표의 위축된 입지와 맞물려 곳곳에서 표출하고 있다. 윤상현 의원은 전날 오세훈 서울시장과 조찬 회동을 한 뒤 “(오 시장이) 당 대표 폐지와 원내 정당화, 국민 공천 제도화를 하자고 말했다”며 “원내 목소리를 모아보려 한다”고 밝혔다. 오 시장은 지난달 국회 특강에선 미국 의회를 예시로 들며 “굳이 당 대표가 필요한가. 원내대표로 충분히 당이 운영된다”고 했다. 주호영 의원은 최근 한 언론에 “이제는 집단지도체제가 필요한 게 아니냐”고 언급했다. 다만 당권파인 김재원 최고위원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 이런 구상은 “현실성이 없다”고 반박했다.)

Jang's diminished influence within the party was also evident during the previous day's closed-door general meeting of lawmakers. Regarding the 'Election Commission Special Counsel Bill,' which was reported to the meeting through a bipartisan agreement, Jang stated his opposition to ratification, arguing that the scope and targets of investigation needed renegotiation. However, as several lawmakers voiced approval, the agreement was ratified with applause. (장 대표의 당내 영향력이 약화된 장면은 전날 비공개 의원총회에서도 포착됐다. 여야 합의로 의총에 보고된 ‘선거관리위원회 특검법안’과 관련, 장 대표가 수사 대상과 범위를 재조율해야 한다며 추인 반대 입장을 밝혔으나 의원 여럿의 찬성 발언이 이어지면서 합의안은 박수로 추인됐다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yu Si-min's "Rotten Smell"... Jeong Cheong-rae: "No Comment" Song Young-gil: "Regrettable" (“썩은 내” 유시민에…정청래 “저는 노코멘트” 송영길 “안타까워”)
item.description:
As influential author within the ruling party Yu Si-min criticized President Lee Jae-myung the previous day with remarks such as "the stench of a rotten fish market" and "the head of the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' movement is Lee Jae-myung himself," fiery reactions poured out from within the Democratic Party of Korea on the 22nd, calling them "nonsensical predictions" and "remarks for the party convention." (여권 내 영향력이 있는 유시민 작가가 전날 “어물전 썩은 내” “(이른바) 뉴 이재명 행동의 수장은 이재명” 등의 발언으로 이재명 대통령을 비판하자 22일 더불어민주당 안에서 “엉터리 예언” “전당대회용 발언”이라는 격앙된 반응이 쏟아졌다.)

Kim Min-seok, a candidate for party leader in the August 17 Democratic Party convention, posted on Facebook that day targeting Yu, saying, "Like false prophecies, this too will inevitably fail" and criticized, "There are no words like 'inevitable failure' or 'rotten smell' in a comrade's language." This was a rebuttal to Yu's criticism following his claim on the 15th that President Lee was headed for "inevitable failure." Song Young-gil, also a party leadership candidate, appeared on Hankyoreh TV's 'News Dive' that day and said, "Yu is inconsistent. Why is he harshly attacking the Lee Jae-myung government? It's regrettable." (김민석 8·17 민주당 전당대회 당대표 후보는 이날 페이스북에 유 작가를 향해 “엉터리 예언처럼 이번에도 필패할 것”이라며 “동지의 언어에 ‘필패’, ‘썩은 내’라는 단어는 없다”고 비판했다. 유 작가가 지난 15일 이 대통령을 향해 “필연적 실패”라고 한 데 이어 또 비판을 하자 이를 반박한 것이다. 송영길 당대표 후보는 이날 한겨레티브이(TV) ‘뉴스다이브’에 나와 “유 작가는 그때그때 다르다. 왜 이재명 정부를 야박하게 공격할까, 안타까움이 있다”고 했다.)

Im Mi-ae, a candidate for Supreme Council member, criticized Yu's claims as "interference in the party convention" on SBS Radio that day, saying, "Wasn't he trying to perfectly time his remarks to rally a specific support base and encourage them to vote?" Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won said on MBC Radio, targeting Yu, "He's just playing a broken recorder. It's too much, and he needs to exercise self-restraint." (임미애 최고위원 후보는 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오에서 “아주 타이밍을 절묘하게 맞춰 특정 지지층을 더 결집하고 투표에 나서라라는 그런 메시지를 주고 싶었던 거 아닌가”라며 유 작가의 주장이 ‘전당대회 개입’이라고 비판했다. 5선 박지원 의원은 문화방송(MBC) 라디오에서 유 작가를 향해 “고장 난 녹음기를 계속 돌리고 있다. 과유불급이고 자숙할 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

In contrast, party leadership candidate Jeong Cheong-rae said in an SBS interview that day regarding Yu's remarks, "I will say no comment. Sometimes silence is better." (반면, 정청래 당대표 후보는 이날 에스비에스 인터뷰에서 유 작가의 발언에 “저는 노코멘트 하겠다. 때로는 침묵하는 것이 더 좋을 때가 있다”고 했다.)

Yu appeared on the YouTube channel '2-Minute News' the previous day and criticized President Lee, stating, "I've judged that the head of the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction is highly likely to be President Lee Jae-myung" and "Absolute power corrupts absolutely. If left unchecked, every fish market is bound to stink." He also cited the prosecution reform process as an example, saying, "After observing the past six months, all the actions of 'New Lee Jae-myung' are not the 'pro-Lee' faction's own uprisings but are planned and initiated by the president and some advisors we don't know well." Yu has been escalating his criticism, using theories like the 'ABC theory,' 'reconstruction theory,' and 'inevitable failure theory' to oppose President Lee's strategy of expanding his base. (유 작가는 전날 유튜브 방송 ‘2분 뉴스’에 나와 “(이른바) ‘뉴 이재명’ 세력의 수장은 이재명 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 판단했다”며 “절대 권력은 100% 부패한다. 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 썩은 내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 이 대통령을 비판했다. 또 검찰개혁 추진 과정 등을 예로 들며 “(지난) 6개월을 지켜본 결과 ‘뉴 이재명’이 하는 모든 행동이 자칭 ‘친명’(친이재명계)들이 벌이는 난동이 아니라 대통령과 우리가 잘 알지 못하는 어떤 참모들이 기획해 시작한 것”이라고 했다. 유 작가는 이 대통령의 외연 확장 기조에 대해 ‘에이비시(ABC)론’ ‘재건축론’ ‘필패론’ 등을 앞세우며 비판 수위를 계속 올리고 있다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party calls 'political judgment' on Oh Se-hoon's first trial verdict that invalidates his election; Democratic Party says 'justice has been served' (국힘, ‘당선무효형’ 오세훈 1심에 “정치판결”…민주 “사필귀정”)
item.description:
Reactions from the ruling and opposition parties were sharply divided after Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon received a sentence that would result in the loss of his mayoral post (a fine of 10 million won) in the first trial for his alleged involvement in the 'opinion poll payment scandal with political broker Myung Tae-kyun.' Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won wrote on Facebook, "Dreams come true. Ironically, Mayor Oh Se-hoon has fulfilled Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's dream of a by-election," and "Mayor Oh, who lied without blinking an eye as Seoul mayor! item.description:

item.title: Korea, US, and Japan foreign ministers meet again after two weeks... discuss South China Sea and North Korea issues targeting China (2주 만에 만난 한미일 외교장관…중국 겨냥 남중국해·북한 문제 논의)
item.description:
The foreign ministers of South Korea, the United States, and Japan held a meeting on the sidelines of the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF) in Manila, the Philippines, where they discussed the South China Sea disputes and cooperation on North Korea, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 22nd (local time). This meeting took place just two weeks after their trilateral foreign ministers' meeting on the sidelines of the NATO summit held in Turkey on the 7th. (한·미·일 외교장관이 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 아세안지역안보포럼(ARF)을 계기로 만나 남중국해 분쟁 및 대북 공조 관련 논의를 했다고 외교부가 22일(현지시각) 밝혔다. 지난 7일 튀르키예에서 열린 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의를 계기로 3국 외교장관회의를 한 뒤 2주 만이다.)

During the trilateral foreign ministers' meeting, Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi exchanged views on the South China Sea disputes involving China. The Ministry stated, "They exchanged views on regional security situations, including attempts to unilaterally change the status quo," and "They reaffirmed their commitment to upholding international law as reflected in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), including freedom of navigation and overflight, and the lawful use of the seas, as well as strengthening maritime security in the Indo-Pacific region, including Southeast Asia." Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs also stated that day, "They exchanged views on ways to engage with Southeast Asian countries and regional situations, including attempts to unilaterally change the status quo through force or coercion, and confirmed close cooperation among the three countries." China has been in conflict with the Philippines and other ASEAN nations over its claims to the South China Sea. (조현 외교부 장관과 마코 루비오 미국 국무장관, 모테기 도시미쓰 일본 외무상은 이날 한미일 외교장관회의에서 중국이 개입된 남중국해 분쟁에 관한 의견을 교환했다. 외교부는 “현상을 일방적으로 변경하려는 시도를 포함하여 역내 정세에 대한 의견을 교환했다”며 “동남아시아를 포함한 인도 태평양 지역에서 항행 및 상공 비행의 자유, 해양의 합법적 이용 등 유엔해양법협약에 반영된 국제법 준수와 해양 안보 강화에 대한 의지를 재확인했다”고 전했다. 일본 외무성도 이날 “동남아시아 국가들에 대한 (3국의) 관여 방식과, 힘이나 강압을 통해 현상을 일방적으로 변경하려는 시도를 포함한 지역 정세에 대해 의견을 교환했으며, 세 나라가 긴밀히 협력하기로 확인했다”고 밝혔다. 중국은 남중국해 영유권을 주장하며 필리핀을 비롯한 아세안 국가들과 갈등을 빚고 있다.)

The Ministry also stated, "The three ministers agreed to maintain close coordination on North Korea policy and to continue communication and cooperation to maintain peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula through dialogue and diplomacy." North Korea did not attend this year's ASEAN Regional Forum. (외교부는 또 “3국 장관들은 대북정책 관련 긴밀한 공조를 유지해 나가기로 하였으며, 대화와 외교를 통한 한반도 평화·안정 유지를 위한 소통과 협력을 지속하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 북한은 올해 아세안지역안보포럼에 참석하지 않았다.)

The three ministers also exchanged views on trends, risk factors, and policy coordination directions in the field of economic security amid the U.S.-China competition in technology and energy. In particular, they discussed expanding cooperation in areas such as protecting advanced technologies, nuclear energy, diversifying and strengthening supply chains, countering economic coercion, and Arctic security. On the 7th, the three countries also signed a Memorandum of Cooperation (MOC) to support the introduction of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) in Indo-Pacific countries, countering the nuclear power competitiveness of China and Russia. This was interpreted as a move towards a "bloc formation" in nuclear energy to counter China and Russia. (세 장관은 미중의 기술·에너지 경쟁 국면에서 경제안보 분야 협력 동향과 위험요인, 정책 공조 방향 등에 대한 의견도 교환했다. 특히 첨단기술 보호와 원자력, 공급망 다변화 및 회복력 증진, 경제적 강압 대응, 북극 안보 등의 분야에서 협력 확대 방안을 논의했다. 세 나라는지난 7일 중국과 러시아의 원전 경쟁력에 맞서 인도·태평양 지역 국가의 소형모듈원자로(SMR) 도입 지원을 위한 협력각서(MOC)도 체결했다. 중·러에 대항한 원전 ‘진영화’ 차원의 움직임으로 해석됐다.)

Meanwhile, it was reported that Minister Cho had a separate conversation with Secretary Rubio after the meeting. Amid numerous issues to be resolved between South Korea and the U.S., such as the Coupang issue, U.S. investments, and delays in security negotiations, it remains to be seen whether high-level discussions took place on these matters. Before the meeting, Minister Cho also had a pull-aside meeting with U.S. Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs Allison Hooker. (한편 조 장관은 회담 뒤 루비오 장관과 따로 대화를 나눈 것으로도 전해졌다. 쿠팡 문제와 대미 투자, 안보협상 지연 등 한미 사이 풀어야 할 사안이 많은 가운데, 고위급 차원에서 관련 대화가 오갔을지 주목된다. 조 장관은 회담 전 앨리슨 후커 미 정무차관과 만나 풀어사이드(약식회담) 회담을 했다.)

Manila / Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (마닐라/장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Seong-ho: "Will investigate if necessary" after warrant rejection for former Cheongju city councilor charged with middle school student sex trafficking (정성호, ‘중학생 성매매’ 전 청주시의원 영장 반려에 “필요하면 감찰”)
item.description:
Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho stated on the 22nd regarding the prosecution's rejection of communication and search and seizure warrants for former Cheongju city councilor Choi Yeong-jung, who is accused of middle school student sex trafficking and illegal filming of sexual exploitation material: "I will examine in detail whether this was an appropriate decision" and "If necessary, I will also conduct an inspection." <<> Minister Jeong responded to this effect during an urgent inquiry at the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, following criticisms from Democratic Party of Korea members of the committee who pointed out that "the prosecution rejected a warrant requested by the police, causing disruptions to the investigation." <<> Minister Jeong stated: "I have strongly reprimanded senior prosecutors, telling them that regarding such issues, our prosecution still lacks sensitivity to the suffering of victims and the sentiments of the general public," and added, "They should investigate actively and, if the police's initial warrant application has deficiencies, consult together to supplement them; they should not handle it this way." He continued: "I apologize if this has caused concern to the public or related individuals." <<> The Cheongju Cheongwon Police Station, about five months after receiving a complaint from the victimized middle school student last February, applied for a communication warrant for former councilor Choi on the 9th. This was intended to check for additional victims, but the Cheongju District Prosecutors' Office rejected it, deeming it as an investigation into a separate case. Regarding the search and seizure warrant applied for by the police, the prosecution requested supplementary investigation, asking for additional search locations and the inclusion of details to specify the workplace address and vehicle. Subsequently, the police re-applied for the search and seizure warrant on the 13th, and it was issued. Former councilor Choi, who was elected as a People Power Party candidate for Cheongju city councilor in the June 3 local elections, voluntarily resigned on the 16th as the compulsory investigation intensified, and was expelled on the 20th. <<> Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min noted: "If there is volatile evidence, a prosecutor can request immediate preservation from communication service providers even without a warrant," and requested, "If preservation measures can be taken even today, please do so." Minister Jeong responded: "I will ensure immediate action." However, Minister Jeong added: "The most important thing is to seize the mobile phone with recorded electronic information, but the police's securing of the phone was rather delayed," and said, "Although the warrant was denied, if the necessity is recognized, one can reapply." <<> Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (정성호 법무부 장관이 22일 중학생 성매매·성착취물 불법 촬영 등 혐의를 받는 최영중 전 청주시의원의 통신영장과 압수수색 영장을 검찰이 반려한 것과 관련 “적정한 판단이었는지 상세히 살펴보겠다”며 “필요하다면 감찰도 해보겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Democrat Party to Handle Bill Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Authority as Early as Next Week (민주, 보완수사권 폐지 법안 이르면 다음주 처리)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has decided to handle a revised Criminal Procedure Act that completely abolishes the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority in the National Assembly as early as next week. It has announced a plan to conclude the controversy over supplementary investigation authority, which has been spreading ahead of the August 17 national convention, at an early stage. (더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권을 완전히 폐지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 이르면 다음주 국회에서 처리하기로 했다. 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 확산하는 보완수사권 논쟁을 조기에 마무리하겠다는 방침을 밝힌 것이다.)

Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party, said at a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly on the 22nd, "The fact that prosecutors do not investigate is the starting point of prosecution reform that separates investigation and prosecution, and there is no disagreement within the party on this major principle." He added, "Differences in detailed perceptions should not shake this principle or become a means to restore the prosecution's investigative authority." Floor leader Han said, "Now is the time to unify the party's consensus. Reform always faces resistance. Even a small loophole allows forces seeking to return to the past to act. If we compromise here, only the signboard of the prosecution office will change to a public prosecution office, but the essence of prosecutorial power will remain." (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 22일 국회 최고위원회의에서 “검사는 수사하지 않는다는 것이 수사와 기소를 분리하는 검찰개혁의 출발점이고, 이 대원칙에는 당내 어떤 이견도 없다”며 “세부적인 인식 차가 이 원칙을 흔들거나 검찰 수사권을 되돌리는 수단이 되어선 안 된다”고 말했다. 한 원내대표는 “이제 당의 총의를 하나로 모을 시점이 왔다”며 “개혁엔 언제나 저항이 따른다. 작은 빈틈이라도 남기면 과거로 돌아가려는 힘이 작동한다. 여기서 타협하면 검찰청 간판만 공소청으로 바뀔 뿐 검찰 권력의 본질은 그대로 남게 된다”고 말했다.)

After 11 lawmakers, including Rep. Hong Gi-won, proposed a revised Criminal Procedure Act on the 14th that stipulated the partial retention of supplementary investigation authority, the Democratic Party leadership said it would undergo a deliberation process but decided on a policy of "complete abolition" within about a week. This is interpreted as an awareness that the supplementary investigation authority issue has become a point of distinction in clarity at the national convention. (민주당 지도부는 지난 14일 홍기원 의원 등 의원 11명이 보완수사권 일부 존치를 규정한 형사소송법 개정안을 발의한 뒤 숙의 과정을 거치겠다고 했으나 일주일여 만에 ‘완전 폐지’ 방침을 정했다. 보완수사권 문제가 전당대회에서 선명성을 가르는 쟁점이 돼버린 상황을 의식한 것으로 풀이된다.)

The party leadership said it would strengthen the right to request supplementary investigation to prevent side effects. Floor leader Han said, "We will substantiate the right to request supplementary investigation, clearly holding investigative agencies accountable to promptly and faithfully fulfill that request." He added, "We will also strongly guarantee victims' rights to file objections, access records, and receive legal assistance." (당 지도부는 보완수사 요구권을 강화해 부작용을 막겠다고 했다. 한 원내대표는 “보완수사 요구권을 실질화해 수사기관이 그 요구를 신속하고 충실하게 이행하도록 책임을 분명히 하겠다”며 “피해자의 이의 신청권과 기록 열람권, 법률 조력을 받을 권리도 두텁게 보장하겠다”고 말했다.)

The Democratic Party is expected to finalize the revised Criminal Procedure Act as early as this month, or at the latest before the August 17 national convention. (민주당은 형사소송법 개정안을 이르면 이번달 안에, 늦어도 8·17 전당대회 전까지는 마무리하겠다는 기류다.)

A source in the floor leadership told The Hankyoreh, "We are not ruling out handling it as early as July, even at a plenary session next week." Another party official said, "We will handle the bill as soon as possible. It won't drag on until the August convention." (한 원내 지도부 관계자는 한겨레에 “빠르면 7월 안에, 다음주 본회의에서 처리하는 것도 배제하지 않는다”고 말했다. 다른 당직자도 “가능한 한 빨리 법안을 처리할 것이다. 8월 전대까지 안 갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

The day before, the Blue House said regarding the supplementary investigation authority issue, "It would be good to reach an early conclusion to reduce unnecessary confusion." (전날 청와대는 보완수사권 문제에 관해 “조기에 결론을 내 불필요한 혼란이 벌어지는 일을 줄이는 게 좋을 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Fires 'Shincheonji Intervention Allegations'… Also Claims "We Need to Examine How the Special Counsel Fell Through" (김민석이 쏘아올린 ‘신천지 개입설’…“특검 무산과정 살펴봐야” 주장도)
item.description:
Amid the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17th national convention, controversy among party leadership contenders over the 'Shincheonji intervention allegations' is escalating, spilling over into a 'truth war' over the collapse of the early-year 'Unification Church-Shincheonji' special counsel probe. Kim Min-seok, a candidate for party leader, appears to be targeting Jeong Cheong-rae, a former party leader and current candidate; Candidate Jeong retaliated, stating, "This is a classic example of unforgivable old-style politics, and I will deliver a firm punishment." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회에서 당권 주자들 사이 ‘신천지 개입설’을 둘러싼 논란이 올해 초 ‘통일교·신천지’ 특검 무산에 대한 ‘진실 공방’까지 옮겨붙으며 과열되고 있다. 김민석 당대표 후보가 전임 대표였던 정청래 당대표 후보를 겨냥하는 모양새인데, 정 후보는 “용서할 수 없는 구태정치의 전형에 강력한 응징을 하겠다”고 맞받았다.)

Lee Geon-tae, a pro-Lee Jae-myung candidate for the Supreme Council, announced on Facebook on the 22nd the establishment of a 'Report Center for Allegations of Shincheonji Intervention in the Democratic Party Convention,' saying, "We are accepting reports." He also added, "We need to verify why the (Unification Church-Shincheonji) special counsel act was halted." Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won said in a radio interview that day regarding the failure of the Unification Church-Shincheonji special counsel, "I acted on instructions from the leadership as (chairman of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's agenda coordination subcommittee), but I believe it was a mistake not to proceed with (the special counsel)." (친명계(친이재명계) 이건태 최고위원 후보는 22일 페이스북에 ‘신천지 민주당 전당대회 개입 의혹 제보센터’ 설치를 알리며 “제보를 받는다”고 밝혔다. 그는 “왜 (통일교·신천지) 특검법이 중단됐는지 확인이 필요하다”고도 했다. 5선 박지원 의원은 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 통일교·신천지 특검 무산에 대해 “(법제사법위 안건조정위원회 위원장으로서) 지도부의 지시를 받고 했지만, 저는 (특검을) 하지 않은 것이 잘못이었다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

This raises questions about the collapse of the Unification Church-Shincheonji special counsel in January, when Candidate Jeong was party leader. At the time, allegations surfaced linking Minister of Oceans and Fisheries Jeon Jae-soo to the Unification Church. The People Power Party demanded a special counsel on the Unification Church, while the Democratic Party countered by demanding a special counsel on Shincheonji (related to the People Power Party's primary), ultimately derailing the special counsel. (이는 정 후보가 대표이던 때인 지난 1월 통일교·신천지 특검이 무산된 것에 의문을 제기한 것이다. 당시 전재수 해양수산부 장관의 ‘통일교 연루 의혹’이 나오자 국민의힘은 통일교 특검 도입을 요구했고, 민주당은 “(국민의힘 경선과 관련된) 신천지 의혹도 특검 하자”고 맞서며 특검은 무산된 바 있다.)

Candidate Kim met with reporters at the National Assembly that day and said, "I only pointed out the problem of Shincheonji's political intervention, and I don't need to take responsibility for linking it to a specific candidate." Song Young-gil, also a candidate for party leader, visited the Jeju April 3rd Peace Park and later told reporters, referencing allegations of Shincheonji's organized party enrollment during the People Power Party's 2021 presidential primary, "There's no rule that such things can't happen in other parties either." (김 후보는 이날 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “저는 신천지 정치 개입 문제점만 지적했고, 그것을 특정 후보와 연결시키는 것에 대해서까지 책임질 필요는 없다”고 했다. 송영길 당대표 후보도 이날 제주4·3평화공원을 참배한 뒤 기자들과 만나 2021년 국민의힘 대선 경선 당시 신천지의 조직적 입당 의혹을 거론하며 “이러한 일들이 다른 정당에도 있지 말란 법이 없다”고 말했다.)

In response, Candidate Jeong posted on Facebook, "When raising Shincheonji allegations, you must provide evidence based on the 5W1H principle. If you can't provide evidence, you must take responsibility yourself," adding, "You should also consider a decision regarding your own position." In an SBS interview that day, he directly challenged Candidate Kim's claim that he "didn't mention a specific candidate," asking, "Are you throwing out accusations with a 'deny if not true' attitude and running away?" He also targeted Candidates Kim and Song, who emphasize expanding the party's support base, saying, "The so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' should be a plus-alpha for the party, but if the main pillar collapses and these people become the party mainstream, I think we'll face many difficulties in future elections." (이에 정 후보는 페이스북에 “신천지 의혹 제기에는 반드시 6하원칙에 의거해 근거를 밝혀야 한다. 근거를 밝히지 못할거면 스스로 책임을 져야 한다”며 “자신의 거취에 대한 결단도 고민해야 하는 사항”이라고 반발했다. 그는 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 인터뷰에서 ‘특정 후보를 이야기하지 않았다’는 김 후보 발언에 대해 “아니면 말고 식으로 던지고 도망가냐”고도 직격했다. 또 “(이른바) ‘뉴 이재명’이 (당의) 플러스알파가 돼야 하는데, 큰 축이 무너지고 그런 분들이 당 주류가 된다면 앞으로 참 많은 선거에서 어려움이 있겠다고 생각했다”며 외연 확장을 앞세우는 김·송 후보를 겨냥했다.)

A two-term lawmaker with weak factional ties commented on the Shincheonji intervention dispute, saying, "They seem to have forgotten that they are candidates for the leader of the ruling party. I don't sense any responsible attitude at all." (계파색이 옅은 한 재선 의원은 신천지 개입 공방에 대해 “집권 여당의 당대표 후보라는 사실을 망각하고 있는 것 같다. 책임 있는 자세가 전혀 느껴지지 않는다”고 말했다.)

By Koh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Speeding up the abolition of supplementary investigation rights to 'block political disputes ahead of convention'... burdened by growing opposition (‘전대 쟁점화 차단’ 보완수사권 폐지 속도전…반대 여론 높아 부담)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea's decision on the 22nd to formalize the 'complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights' and accelerate the processing of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment is interpreted as a move to prevent this issue from being used as fodder for 'competition for clarity' in the lead-up to the August 17 party convention. However, with considerable public opinion expressing concern over the abolition of supplementary investigation rights, devising follow-up measures remains a challenge. <<> Acting Democratic Party leader and floor leader Han Byeong-do stated at a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly that "detailed differences in perception must not shake the principle of separating investigation and indictment, nor become a means to restore the prosecution's investigation powers," announcing the policy of completely abolishing supplementary investigation rights. He said, "The Democratic Party will substantiate the right to request supplementary investigations and clearly establish the responsibility of investigative agencies to promptly and faithfully comply with such requests," mentioning measures including △requests for replacement and disciplinary action of investigators in cases of negligent investigations, △a cross-investigation system where the police and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office check and balance each other, △strengthening police investigation reviews and external inspections, and △introducing victims' right to object and right to access records. <<> The floor leader's statement came amid growing 'cautious' voices within the Democratic Party, triggered by cases like that of Jang Yoon-gi. The presidential office's position the previous day, suggesting it would be better to "conclude the matter early to reduce unnecessary confusion," appears to have influenced the decision. The Rebuilding Korea Party also pressured the Democratic Party the day before by urging legislation for 'complete abolition within July' and using cooperation to end the filibuster as leverage. With all party leadership candidates sharing the same stance on the abolition of supplementary investigation rights, the party's leadership felt compelled to make a swift decision. There was also a strong voice for speeding up the process, as only about two months remain until the establishment of the Public Prosecution Service and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office in October. A Democratic Party lawmaker serving a second term in the Seoul metropolitan area told *The Hankyoreh*, "It's right to remove the issue before the party convention. It's not desirable for the vote to be divided over this," adding, "With the Public Prosecution Service launching soon, we need to settle this for now." <<> Even lawmakers within the party who have argued for allowing exceptional supplementary investigation rights seem to be converging on the idea of 'legislation first, supplementation later.' A lawmaker who co-signed Representative Hong Ki-won's bill said, "The key is how quickly and precisely we can remedy the victims' damages," adding, "The party has said it will do its best to supplement (the concerns arising from the complete abolition), so I'll wait and see." Another lawmaker simply stated, "I will follow the party's judgment." <<> Recent opinion polls showing a predominance of opposition to abolishing supplementary investigation rights are likely to act as a burden during the legislative process. In a survey released on the 22nd by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI), opposition to the abolition stood at 55.3%, overwhelmingly surpassing support (27.4%). A Gallup Korea survey from the 14th to the 16th also found that 61% believed supplementary investigation rights should be 'maintained,' far exceeding the 23% who favored 'complete abolition.' Park Chan-woon, a professor at Hanyang University's Law School who attended the Democratic Party's policy meeting the previous day and argued for 'partial retention,' told *The Hankyoreh* in a phone call, "This is a very unfortunate decision from the perspective of the majority of the people who believe maintaining supplementary investigation rights is necessary." <<> Reporters: Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr, Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 22일 ‘검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 방침을 공식화하고 형사소송법 개정안 처리 속도전에 들어간 것은 8·17 전당대회 국면에서 이 문제가 ‘선명성 경쟁’의 재료로 소비되는 것을 차단하겠다는 계산에 따른 결정으로 해석된다. 그러나 보완수사권 폐지에 우려를 나타내는 여론이 적지 않은 상황에서 후속 장치 마련은 과제로 남아 있다.)
